'''Cook's Assistant''' is the first ''[[Old School RuneScape|RuneScape]]'' [[Quests|quest]] ever released and one of the six quests available during the game's launch. In the quest, the player must help the [[Cook (Lumbridge)|cook]] of [[Lumbridge Castle]] make a birthday [[cake]] for [[Duke Horacio]].

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to the [[Cook (Lumbridge)|Cook]] in the kitchen of [[Lumbridge Castle]].
|startmap = 3208,3214
|difficulty = Novice
|description = The Lumbridge Castle cook is in a mess. It is the Duke of Lumbridge's birthday and the cook is making the cake.

He needs a lot of ingredients and doesn't have much time.
|length = Very Short
|items = * [[Egg]] (can be obtained during the quest)
* [[Bucket of milk]]
**A [[bucket]] (if obtaining the milk during the quest)
* [[Pot of flour]]
**A [[pot]] (if obtaining the flour during the quest)
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Asgarnia}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
This quest is typically among the first to be completed by new players and is intended to encourage exploration of [[Lumbridge]]. However, for non [[Ironmen]] players, it is possible to skip gathering the ingredients yourself by purchasing the items on the [[Grand Exchange]] before speaking to the [[Cook (Lumbridge)|Cook]], allowing for the quest to be completed in seconds.

===A feast for a Duke===
[[File:Cook (Lumbridge) chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Begin the quest by speaking with the Lumbridge [[Cook (Lumbridge)|cook]] found in the kitchen on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of [[Lumbridge Castle]]. He mentions it is [[Duke Horacio]]'s birthday and that he is supposed to bake the Duke a [[cake]]. Unfortunately, however, he has forgotten to buy the ingredients and asks the player to bring him a [[bucket of milk]], an [[egg]], and a [[pot of flour]].

====Bucket and pot====
A [[bucket]] spawns in the cellar of Lumbridge Castle, and a [[pot]] spawns in the kitchen on the centre table. You can also purchase both a bucket and a pot from the [[Lumbridge General Store]] for {{NoCoins|2}} and {{NoCoins|1}} [[coins]], respectively.

====Egg====
{{Map
|align=right
|x=3166
|y=3288
|mtype=pin
|x:3181,y:3288,icon:redPin,desc:Chicken coop
|x:3177,y:3315,icon:bluePin,desc:Dairy cow field
|x:3163,y:3289,icon:yellowPin,desc:Wheat field
|caption={{mapkey
 |title=Ingredient locations
 |line1=...red,text=Chicken coop
 |line2=...blue,text=Dairy cow field
 |line3=...yellow,text=Wheat field
}}
}}
Go east out of [[Lumbridge Castle]] and run north along the path until you reach the [[chicken]] [[coop]] north-west of [[Fred the Farmer|Farmer Fred]]'s house. Go into the coop and pick up an [[egg]].

====Bucket of milk====
With an empty [[bucket]], go north into the [[cow]] pasture. Use the empty bucket on a [[dairy cow]] (distinguishable by its cowbell) to get a [[bucket of milk]]. You can optionally talk to [[Gillie Groats]] for an explanation on how to milk a cow. She can be found across the [[River Lum|river]] next to the dairy cow in the eastern [[Lumbridge cow field]].

The cook will also accept milk that is in a [[bottomless bucket of milk]], taking one bucket worth of milk from it.

====Pot of flour====
With an empty [[pot]], leave the cow pasture and go south-west to the wheat field. Pick some [[grain]], and then enter the [[Mill Lane Mill]], found up the road to the north-east. Climb to the top floor, put the grain in the hopper, then pull the lever and climb back down to the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}. Finally, use an empty pot on the [[flour bin]] (which is now full of flour) to get a [[pot of flour]]. You can optionally talk to [[Millie Miller]] inside the mill for an explanation on how to make [[pot of flour|flour]].

===Delivery===
After collecting the ingredients, speak to the [[Cook (Lumbridge)|cook]] to deliver them.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

{{Clear}}

==Rewards==
{{Quest rewards
|name = Cook's Assistant
|image=[[File:Cook's Assistant reward scroll.png|centre]]
|qp = 1
|rewards = 
* {{SCP|Cooking|300|link=yes}} [[experience]]
* Permission to use the [[Cooking range (Lumbridge Castle)|Cook-o-matic 100]], which reduces the chance of burning some [[food]]s.
}}

==Required for completing==
The completion of Cook's Assistant is a requirement to complete the following:
* [[Recipe for Disaster]]
* [[Easy Lumbridge & Draynor Diary]]: ''Bake some bread on the Lumbridge castle kitchen range.''

==Trivia==
* In the [[Death to the Dorgeshuun]] quest, when you introduce [[Zanik]] to the [[Cook (Lumbridge)|cook]], he tries to offer the quest to her, saying, "In fact, it's a good thing I met you. It's the Duke's birthday today, and I should be making him a lovely big birthday cake. I need eggs, flour, and milk..." The player then tells the cook that Zanik does not have time for that, to which he responds, "It was worth a try." This insinuates that the cook asks all newcomers to bring him supplies.
* During the [[20th Anniversary event]], it was revealed that the cook has attempted and failed to bake a cake countless times, explaining his recurring need for ingredients from new adventurers.
* The [[Cook (servant)|cook]] at the [[Servants' Guild]] of [[Ardougne]] references this quest in her dialogue, saying, "Overnight I was fired and replaced by some fool who can't even bake a cake without help!"

'''Demon Slayer''' is one of six quests released with the launch of ''[[RuneScape Classic]]''. In it, players are tasked with protecting [[Varrock]] from a powerful [[demon]].

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Aris]] in the tent on the western side of [[Varrock Square]].
|startmap = 3203,3424
|difficulty = Novice
|description = A mighty demon is being summoned to destroy the city of Varrock. You find out you are the one destined to stop him (or at least try).
|length = Short
|requirements = The ability to defeat a level 27 [[Delrith|demon]] aided by three level 20 [[Dark wizard]]s and two level 7 Dark wizards using the [[Silverlight]] in melee.
|items = *A [[water]] container, such as a [[bucket of water]] (obtainable during the quest)
*25 [[bones]] (can't be [[noted]], but can be delivered in increments)
*1 [[coin]]
|kills = [[Delrith]] ''(level 27)''
|recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|15|link=yes}}
*[[Armour]] and some [[food]]
*Fast travel to several locations
**[[Varrock]] to start the quest - [[Varrock teleport]] or [[Chronicle]] or [[Skills necklace]] to [[Cooks' Guild]] ''([[Members only]])'' or [[Ring of wealth]] to [[Grand Exchange]] ''(Members only)''
**[[Wizard's Tower]] (1 trip) - [[Necklace of passage]] or [[Amulet of the Eye]] or [[Amulet of glory]] to [[Draynor Village]] ''(All Members only)''
**[[Champions' Guild]] (1 trip) - [[Chronicle]] or [[Combat bracelet]] ''(Members only)'' or [[Varrock Teleport]]
|leagueRegion = <poem>
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Desert}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
===Scrying the future===
{{Needed|3 empty inventory spaces, 1 [[gold coin]].}}
[[File:Demon Slayer - Wally.png|thumb|left|300px|[[Wally]] slaying Delrith.]]
Speak to [[Aris]] in the tent on the western side of [[Varrock Square]]. Pay her one [[coin]] and she will scry the future, seeing a vision of the player wielding an impressive sword fighting a demon named [[Delrith]], who terrorized Varrock over a century prior. Delrith was previously defeated by a hero named [[Wally]]; just your luck, the demon is being summoned again. Ask Aris where you can find the demon, and she will mention that to defeat him you must first find Wally's sword [[Silverlight]].

Ask Aris, ''"So, how did Wally kill Delrith?"'' She will show you the incantation Wally used: write down or screenshot the phrase, as it will be important later on. '''The word order of this spell is randomised for every player.''' After telling you the incantation, she tells you to talk to [[Sir Prysin]] to help.

Go north to [[Varrock Palace]]. [[Sir Prysin]] will be wandering the south-west portion of the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of the castle. Talk to him and tell him that Aris sent you. Ask for [[Silverlight]], the weapon needed to kill Delrith. He will tell you that to prevent the weapon from falling into the wrong hands, it was put into a special box that requires three different keys to open it. He has dropped his key in the drain just outside the palace kitchen, and the other two are in the possession of [[Captain Rovin]] and the Wizard [[Traiborn]].
{{Listen
|title = [[Wally the Hero]]
|align = right
|filename = Wally the Hero.ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays while Wally defeats Delrith.}}
{{Clear}}
===Captain Rovin's key===
[[File:Captain Rovin chathead.png|left|frameless]]
[[Captain Rovin]] is located in the north-west corner of the palace on the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}}, up two flights of stairs. Talk to him and tell him that you need the key in order to recover [[Silverlight]] to slay a demon that threatens the city. Mention that Sir Prysin said Captain Rovin would give the key to you, to which he will rant about the King being the only one to tell him what to do. Next, ask him why Sir Prysin gave the key to him in the first place, and he'll state the King made Sir Prysin give him the key so that it wouldn't get lost. After this dialogue, he'll then hand over the key, under the condition that you do not allow Sir Prysin to kill the demon.

[[File:Demon Slayer - Wizard Traiborn's wardrobe.gif|thumb|250px|Wizard Traiborn casts a spell to summon a wardrobe containing his key]]

===Sir Prysin's key===
{{Needed|[[Bucket of water]] or a similar container of water.}}
[[File:Sir Prysin chathead.png|left|frameless]]
On the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of the palace, head to the kitchen in the north-east corner of the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}}. If you do not already have a container of water, you can find an empty [[bucket]] up the stairs, in the bedroom to the north-east. With the bucket, return to the kitchen and use it on the sink to obtain a bucket of water.

Next, head outside through kitchen door and look for a [[Drain (Demon Slayer)|drain]] against the wall north of the doorway. '''Use your container of water on the drain. You must do this, or the key will not appear during the next step.''' The key will be washed down the drain, so you must now retrieve it from the [[Varrock Sewers|sewer]] below. Head east, out of the palace, and look for a [[manhole]] located south of the palace's east walls. It is marked by the [[File:Dungeon icon.png]] icon on the [[minimap]]. Once you find it, open the manhole and climb down to enter the sewer.

<!-- This doesn't use the regular map template because it cannot draw text labels; the GeoJSON used as an alternative is somewhat bloated, and therefore placed in mapspace and transcluded here-->{{Map:Demon Slayer key location}}{{clear}}

While in the sewer, go north-west and follow the path highlighted on the map above until you reach a stream. You should see a muddy patch to your left, next to a pile of skeletons. Examine this and you will find a [[Silverlight_key_(Sir_Prysin)|rusty key]].

===Wizard Traiborn's key===
{{Needed|25 unnoted [[bones]]. You can save some time by having all of the bones when you first speak to him. An easy way to get the bones is to kill [[Goblin|goblins]] south of the prison outside of Draynor Village}}
[[File:Wizard Traiborn chathead.png|left|frameless|width=138x138]]
[[Wizard Traiborn]] is located on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Wizards' Tower]], which stands on an island south of [[Draynor Village]]. Ask him about the key and at first he won't remember it - but once you ask whether he has 'any keys knocking around', he will recall that he sealed it inside a magical wardrobe, for which he needs 25 regular [[bones]] to open. 

Once all 25 bones have been delivered, Traiborn will perform his ritual and then give you his key. Note that you can deliver the bones in increments, so [[File:Ultimate ironman chat badge.png]] Ultimate Ironmen will not need to clear out their inventory to complete this step.

'''If you die with the key, you will have to pay another 25 bones to re-retrieve it.'''

[[File:Silverlight detail.png|thumb|width=255x255|The mighty sword Silverlight.]]

=== Silverlight ===
Now that you have all three keys, head back to [[Sir Prysin]] in Varrock. Give him the keys, and he will give you [[Silverlight]]. Players can drop Silverlight and ask Sir Prysin for another one for free; after the quest he will charge {{Coins|500}}. Equip the sword, get any [[food]] and [[armour]] you may need for combat, and prepare to fight Delrith.

''If you have forgotten the magical incantation, you can speak with Aris at her tent in Varrock Square to hear it again.''

When you're ready, head south of [[Varrock]], and go east towards the stone circle surrounded by [[dark wizard]]s. A [[cutscene]] will play of [[Delrith]] being summoned by the wizards after you enter the circle.
===Banishing Delrith===
[[File:Demon Slayer - Summoning ritual.png|thumb|220px|The dark wizards attempt to summon Delrith!]]
{{Needed|recommended=[[food]] and [[armour]].}}
[[File:Dark wizard chathead.png|left|frameless]]
[[File:Demon Slayer - Delrith is summoned.png|thumb|220px|Delrith is summoned!]]
{{Listen
|title = [[Delrith (music track)|Delrith]]
|align = right
|filename = Delrith.ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays upon Delriths summoning.}}
The final part takes place in an [[instance]] of the [[Varrock]] [[stone circle]], with Delrith and several [[dark wizard]]s (two level 7 wizards and a level 20 wizard). Level 7 and 20 wizards will be [[aggressive]] to players with lower than 15 or 41 [[combat level]] respectively. Additionally, upon the cutscene finishing for the first time, one of the level 7 wizards will attack regardless of combat level. The level 20 wizard's maximum hit of 6 can threaten players with a low [[Hitpoints]] level, especially if the player has negative [[Magic Defence]] bonus. '''To leave, run to the edge at any time during the fight.'''

Because the fight takes place in a [[single-way combat]] zone, if you are already under attack from a dark wizard, you will need to kill or hide from it before you are able to begin combat with Delrith. It is recommended for lower-level players to approach from the south, and hide from wizards behind the southernmost stone wall until Delrith is nearby. Since the wizards '''do not respawn''' in the instance, it is also possible to kill them first, leave and restock, and then return to face Delrith.

Attack Delrith with Silverlight equipped. Despite his combat level of 27, the Silverlight's weakening effect will reduce Delrith's hitpoints to less than that of a [[cow]]. When he reaches 0 hitpoints, say the magical incantation. If the wrong incantation is said, Delrith regenerates to full health. '''If you cannot remember your personal randomized incantation you can return to Aris and she will repeat it when prompted.''' 

==== Pures and lower levels ====
For those wishing to attack with magic, wielding Silverlight and manually casting spells will also deal damage. Other methods include [[flinch|flinching]] him or using [[Confuse]], [[Curse]], or [[Weaken]] to make him easier to kill with melee. [[Ring of recoil|rings of recoil]] can be used for this fight. <!-- is combat xp normal? -->

If you take too long<!-- how long? --> to finish off [[Delrith]], he will disappear and you will need to leave and re-enter the instance. If Delrith disappears during the dialogue to banish him the quest can still be completed by pressing "continue" until the end.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Rewards==
{{Obsolete|The image doesn't include the new quest rewards.|update=Quest Month Kick Off, TFA Tweaks & More}}

|image = [[File:Demon Slayer reward scroll.png|centre]]

*5 [[Kudos]], which [[members]] can claim by talking to [[Historian Minas]] in the [[Varrock Museum]]
*2 [[Antique lamp (Demon Slayer)|antique lamps]] giving 1,000 XP each in any combat skill, including Prayer
}}

'''Doric's Quest''' is a quest involving [[Doric]] the dwarf, who is happy to let the player use his anvils but first requests an errand.

==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Doric]] in the small house north of [[Falador]], just outside the east gate of [[Taverley]].
|startmap = 2952,3451
|difficulty = Novice
|description = Doric the dwarf is happy to let you use his anvils but first he would like you to run an errand for him.
|length = Very Short
|requirements = None
|items = 
* 6 [[clay]] (not [[soft clay]])
* 4 [[copper ore]]s
* 2 [[iron ore]]s
|recommended = 
* [[Pickaxe]] and {{SCP|Mining|15|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} if you wish to mine the ores yourself ([[bronze pickaxe]] obtained during the quest)
|ironman = 
*A method of obtaining [[iron ore]]:
**{{SCP|Mining|15|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} to mine it
**As a 1/20 drop from [[Flesh Crawlers]] in the [[Stronghold of Security]]
**As a 1/8.667 drop from [[Mind Golem]]s in the [[Ruins of Camdozaal]] (requires {{SCP|Quest}} [[Below Ice Mountain]])
**As a drop from [[Iron ore#Item sources|other monsters]]
|leagueRegion = <poem>
{{LeagueRegion|Asgarnia}} — location requirement
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Desert}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest
</poem>
}}

==Walkthrough==
===Getting started===
{{Map|name=Doric|x=2952|y=3452|r=4|height=250|width=250|mtype=square|align=right|caption=The quest's start location.}}
[[Doric]] can be found in a small building on the crossroads north of [[Falador]], east of the [[Taverley]] gate, and south of the [[Goblin Village]].

Ask Doric if you could use his [[whetstone]] or [[anvil]]. Doric will tell you he needs some materials in order to manufacture some [[pickaxe]]s. He will hand you a [[bronze pickaxe]]. He wants you to get him:

*6 [[clay]] 
*4 [[copper ore]]s
*2 [[iron ore]]s

(''These cannot be noted'')

These materials must be turned in all at once ''(12 inventory slots)''.

===Obtaining the materials===
''(Skip this part if you already have all of the required materials)''

Where you obtain the ores does not matter, and can for example be obtained from other players or by mining the ores yourself (15 [[Mining]] is required for [[iron ore]]).

The [[Dwarven Mine]] is located near Doric's house, so you can head there. To get there, go east from Doric's house and then north to find a path onto [[Ice Mountain]]. On the mountain, walk south and look for a ladder surrounded by buildings and [[Dwarf|dwarves]]. Climb down the ladder to enter the Dwarven Mine. The [[Iron rocks|iron]], [[Copper rocks|copper]], and [[tin rocks]] are located due south of the entrance. [[Clay rocks]] are located a little further south.

[[Dwarf|Dwarves]] located outside the [[Dwarven Mine]], east of Doric's house, sometimes drop [[iron ore]]. This may help [[Ironmen]] trying to complete this quest before level 15 [[Mining]]. [[Members]] can buy the copper ores and iron ores at [[Ore Seller|the store]] in [[Blast Furnace]]. [[Ironmen]] can also complete the quest before reaching level 15 Mining by [[pickpocketing]] [[H.A.M. Member|H.A.M members]] as they have an uncommon chance to give [[Iron ore]]. Also you can kill for example [[Sand Crab|Sand]] or [[Rock Crab]]s which drop both copper and iron.

Alternatively, instead of mining in the Dwarven Mine, you can use the [[Rimmington mine]] south of Falador, which contains all the required ores right next to each other.

===Finishing up===
When you have all the ores needed, return to [[Doric]] to finish the quest. He will appreciate your help, reward you, and allow you to use his [[anvil]]s whenever you'd like.

Help [[Sir Amik Varze]] and infiltrate the fortress to find out what the [[Kinshra|Black Knights]] are planning and put a stop to it. ==Details== {{Quest details |start = Talk to [[Sir Amik Varze]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} of the [[White Knights' Castle]]'s western tower in [[Falador]]. |startmap = 2959,3336,plane:2 |difficulty = Intermediate |description = The Black Knights are up to no good. You are hired by the white knights to spy on them and destroy their secret weapon. |length = Very Short |requirements = * {{SCP|Quest|12}} [[Quest points]] {{Questreqstart|yes}} * The ability to evade level 33 [[Black Knight]]s |items = * [[Cabbage]] (can be obtained from the cabbage patch in [[Edgeville Monastery]] and [[South Falador Farm]], as well as [[Lumbridge Castle#Cellar|Lumbridge cellar]]. '''Dragon Slayer I''' is a [[quest]] that focuses on the player's journey to slay [[Elvarg]], the [[Dragon (race)|dragon]] of [[Crandor]]. Often described as the hardest, yet most rewarding quest available to [[free-to-play]] players, those who successfully complete it gain the ability to equip the [[rune platebody]] and [[green d'hide body]] (as well as their many variations), in addition to the [[dragon platebody]].

Starting this quest is required to use any [[Dragonfire#Protection|dragonfire protection]], although it does not need to be completed. It also allows [[Dragon (race)|dragons]] to be received as a [[Slayer task]].

A grandmaster-difficulty sequel to the quest called [[Dragon Slayer II]] was released on [[4 January]] [[2018]].

==Walkthrough==

===The Champions' Guild and Oziach===
[[File:Guildmaster.png|left|frameless|width=250x250]]
Head to the [[Champions' Guild]] immediately south of the southern gates of [[Varrock]] and ask the [[Guildmaster]] for a quest. He will tell you to visit [[Oziach]], the maker of rune platebodies, who sets the tasks that champions must complete to earn the right to wear one. 

Oziach can be found in the north-west corner of [[Edgeville]], near the [[Wilderness ditch]] and the [[Edgeville Monastery]]. Speak to him, and he will set the player the task of killing the dragon of [[Crandor]].

Return to the Guildmaster, who will recount the tale of [[Elvarg]], the dragon that laid waste to the whole of Crandor, leaving a trio of wizards as the sole survivors. To reach Crandor, the player will need a ship capable of getting through dangerous reefs, a map to show the way, and protection against the dragon's breath.

'''''Important:''' Ask him '''all the follow up questions below'''; each one unlocks a stage of the quest. You will need to return later if you do not.''

Ask him how you can find the route to Crandor, and he will tell you that only one map exists - it was split into three pieces, each held by a wizard.

Ask him where to find each map piece, and he will give you information about each piece, as well as give you a [[Maze key]] (requires free inventory space). 

Ask him where you can find the right ship, and he will suggest looking in Port Sarim. 

Ask him how to protect against the dragon's breath, and he will mention that [[Duke Horacio]] has a special shield which is enchanted against dragon's breath.

===Obtaining the anti-dragon shield===
[[File:Duke Horacio chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Non-[[Ironman Mode|ironmen]] may purchase the [[Anti-dragon shield]] on the [[Grand Exchange]] for {{Coins|{{GEP|Anti-dragon shield}}}}. Alternatively, you can obtain one for free from [[Duke Horacio]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of [[Lumbridge Castle]]. The [[drop trick]] can be used to obtain several shields, which may be useful if you  die during the dragon fight and need to return, as Elvarg shoots dragonfire immediately upon entering her arena.
{{Clear}}
===Three pieces make a whole ===
The three map pieces may be collected in any order. After collecting all three, use any piece on another, and all three pieces will combine to form [[Crandor map]].

====Melzar====
{{Main|Melzar's Maze}}'''''Items required:''' The [[Maze key]], [[food]], and [[combat]] [[equipment]]. (The most difficult enemy is the [[Lesser demon (Melzar's Maze)|lesser demon]]; you can [[safespot]] it with [[Magic]]/[[Ranged]] and with [[melee]] as well.)''
[[File:Melzar the Mad chathead.png|left|frameless|width=80x80]]
Head to [[Melzar's Maze]] for the first map piece, located north-west of [[Rimmington]], south of the [[Crafting Guild]], and west of [[Port Sarim]], with your [[Maze key]] and [[combat equipment]]. [[Food]] is recommended for lower level players.

===Lady Lumbridge===
{{Needed|A [[hammer]], 90 [[steel nails]], 3 [[plank]]s, [[Crandor map]], and 2,000 [[coins]]}}
[[File:Klarense chathead.png|left|frameless]]
[[File:Dragon Slayer - Repairing Lady Lumbridge.png|thumb|right|200px|Repairing the hole in your slightly-used ship.]]
[[File:Dragon Slayer - Crandor map.png|thumb|left|200px|Crandor Map with all 3 pieces combined.]]
Take your nails, planks, [[hammer]], and {{Coins|2000}}, and head to [[Port Sarim]]. If you do not yet have a hammer, you can buy one from a [[Trader Crewmember]] on the dock to the south (Members only). Nine planks can be made at the [[sawmill]] in [[free-to-play]], but only once. The [[Sawmill operator]] will only talk to you after you have purchased the ship.

Look for [[Klarense]], a sailor, who is located on the second-most southern dock. Talk to him and he will ask if you are interested in buying his ship, the [[Lady Lumbridge]]. Reply that you'd like to buy her, and he will sell you the ship for {{Coins|2000}}. 

The boat is not yet seaworthy, and you will need to fix it first. Board the ship and climb down the ladder. Patch the hole in the ship's hull by clicking it three times, and the ship will be seaworthy again.

You now need to find a captain to sail it. Go to [[Draynor Village]] and talk to [[Ned]], located in the house just north-east of the [[Wise Old Man]]'s home. Ask him if he will take you to Crandor, and he'll agree to sail you to Crandor '''if''' you have already repaired the ship and hand him the [[Crandor map]].

===Preparing for the fight===
{{Needed|[[Anti-dragon shield]], [[combat equipment]] and [[food]]|recommended=Quick escapes, like [[teleport]] [[runes]], [[teleport tablets]] or the [[ectophial]]. [[Antifire potion]]s, and [[Prayer potions]] or [[restore potions]]}}

==== Dragonfire ====

Without the use of [[Dragonfire#Protection|dragonfire protection]], [[Elvarg]]'s [[dragonfire]] can deal up to '''70''' damage at range. Equipping an [[anti-dragon shield]] is '''highly recommended''' to mitigate this at a minimum; [[Protect from Magic]] will also reduce some of the damage.  Members may also drink an [[antifire potion]] or [[super antifire potion]] in combination with the other two methods.

See the below table for the maximum damage Elvarg will deal based on your combination of dragonfire protection used.

{{:Dragonfire/Elvarg}}

Note that every dragonfire attack from Elvarg will also drain 10% of your remaining [[Prayer]], rounded down.

====General preparations====

As well as dragonfire protection, consider taking [[prayer potions]] or [[restore potions]] with you for when Elvarg drains your prayer, if you plan to use it during the battle.

Lower levelled players may find it useful to use [[rings of recoil]] to deal additional damage, as Elvarg's fast hits make it particularly useful in dealing back damage.

The rest of your inventory should be filled with [[food]] - [[lobster]]s (12 HP) should be enough for most players with a [[combat level]] of around 40 and appropriate gear, but [[swordfish]] (14 HP) or higher would be useful.

You may also consider taking a [[teleportation]] method with you, either to escape death or to leave the island after killing her.

'''Note''': While it will allow you to set up a cannon in the area, it will not attack Elvarg.

====Choosing a combat style====
Before fighting Elvarg, you'll need to choose a ''[[Combat triangle|combat style]]'': melee, ranged or magic.

'''Melee'''

This is the preferred style, as Elvarg will not solely use her dragonfire attack but also melee attacks when standing next to her, and the latter are less powerful. You may also consider using [[flinching]] (see the tips section below for more information).

Equip good-quality armour; preferably [[adamant armour]] or better.

Like all [[Dragon (race)|dragons]], Elvarg is weak to [[stab]] attacks; see the page about [[Attack types]]. As such, consider wielding a [[Stab weapons|stab weapon]]: a shortsword or dagger instead of a scimitar. Adamant or better is recommended. For [[free-to-play]] players, a [[rune shortsword]] is recommended as it possesses the highest stab bonus in F2P, with its aggressive style the optimum for most players. A  [[rune longsword]], [[rune scimitar]], [[rune battleaxe|battleaxe]] or [[rune mace|mace]] are less effective but may still do decent enough damage.

Elvarg is not immune to [[poison]], so adding [[weapon poison]] would turn the battle even more in your favour; thus a poisoned [[dagger]] would be effective.

'''Ranged'''

Elvarg is also weak against [[Ranged|ranged attacks]], but as you should be using an [[Anti-dragon shield]], you must use a one-handed weapon such as a [[crossbow (weapon)|crossbow]]. This may be trickier for Free-to-play players who only have access to the weakest types and [[bronze bolts]]. For Members this is more viable, and they should use the best crossbow with the best [[bolts]] they can use (preferably poisoned).

Make sure you have [[Auto Retaliate]] on and select the [[Combat Options#Rapid|Rapid]] firing style.

'''Magic'''

While Elvarg, like many other dragons, has somewhat strong defences against magic, she has a 30% [[elemental weakness]] to [[water spells]]. This means that water spells have their accuracy and damage increased by 30% against her. As such, mages should use the strongest water spell they have available.

===Travelling to Crandor & locating Elvarg===
{{Map|2840,3268|align=left|width=220|height=280|zoom=2|caption=The surface of Crandor.}}
[[File:Dragon Slayer - Cabin boy Jenkins fried.png|thumb|right|A reason why dragonfire protection is needed to face Elvarg.]]

Head back to and board your ship to meet up with Ned and Cabin boy Jenkins. Speak with Ned to depart and a cutscene will begin...

After crashing on the southern side of [[Crandor|the island]], make your way to the top of the volcano (the [[dungeon]] marker on your [[minimap]]), avoiding [[aggressive]] [[skeletons]], [[moss giants]], [[hobgoblins]], and [[lesser demons]]. Enter the hole and a short cutscene plays, followed by abruptly finding yourself surrounded by [[Skeleton#Level 25|skeletons (level 25)]]. Down the corridor you'll find large [[Skeleton#Level 45|skeletons (level 45)]], and you'll see Elvarg in the main chamber behind stalagmites and stalactites. 

'''Note''': If you are a [[Member]], you can climb back up the rope to complete a medium task in the [[Karamja Diary]], then climb back down.

'''Note:''' Before fighting Elvarg, there is a wall to the south you can open. Once opened, it will allow you to travel back to Crandor from the [[Karamja Volcano]], by climbing down the rocks on the eastern side of the volcano, then heading north. If you die during the fight, you would otherwise need the materials to repair the boat again (90 steel nails, 3 planks and a hammer). Once you have unlocked this shortcut, trying to repair the ship will result in the message {{Mes|You don't need to mess about with broken ships now that you have found the secret passage from Karamja}}, and you will be unable to use it to return to Crandor. After the quest has been completed, you will be able to return to Crandor via the [[Karamja Volcano]] regardless of whether you opened it during the quest or not.

Now, go back to the main chamber, climb over the low stalagmites, and fight Elvarg (see section below for tips).

===Tips for the fight & potential strategies===
[[File:Dragon Slayer - Fighting Elvarg.png|thumb|left|250px|A player battles against Elvarg, the destroyer of Crandor. In the top-left, the remains of the original adventurer who woke the dragon can be seen.]]

*Make sure that you have your dragonfire protection active before you enter the arena, as Elvarg, unlike other [[Green dragon|green dragons]], can use dragonfire attacks at a distance.

*You may consider standing under Elvarg while eating, as it takes her a moment to move and hit you again.

*If you happen to teleport away during battle, she will take some time before fully healing, and may still be missing health if you can return quickly.

* Aside from teleporting, you can exit the arena whenever you'd like, however re-entering the arena will result in guaranteed dragon fire attack.

* Members who are unable to kill Elvarg in one trip may choose to escape through the shortcut to Karamja and go through the cave entrance to [[Mor Ul Rek]] to get extra food from their bank. If you return quickly, Elvarg will not have enough time to heal. Be sure to keep enough food to survive being hit by monsters on the way.

[[File:Elvarg safespot.png|thumb|right|250px|A player standing in a safespot to heal up, or to use the flinching method.]]

*Elvarg can be [[Flinching|flinched]] using melee attacks. Flinching is a combat tactic that entails attacking an opponent while it is out of combat and going to a [[safespot]] before the monster can retaliate. This can and will still go wrong every now and then, so it is still recommended to bring food and have a decent combat level.

*To flinch her, stand in the south-eastern corner of her cave, in the game square directly next to the north-west corner of the little lava pool. You'll also need to get Elvarg to stand directly left of the skeleton on the ground to the north-west. (See the image for the place to stand.) If you pull this off, she will be unable to hit you; this is a safespot. From there, begin to attack her, and immediately click on the north-west corner (don't click on a rat) of the little lava pool to walk back to the safespot. Wait for Elvarg's health bar to disappear, and repeat the process.
{{clear}}

===Returning to Oziach===
[[File:Dragon Slayer - Elvarg slain.png|thumb|250x250px|A player beheads Elvarg]]
[[File:Elvarg's head detail.png|left|140px]]
Once [[Elvarg]] is defeated and you have triumphed, you will automatically collect [[Elvarg's head]] if you have a free inventory slot (not required to complete the quest). 
{{Listen
|title = [[A Slayer's Feat (Dragon Slayer)|A Slayer's Feat]]
|align = right
|filename = A Slayer's Feat (Dragon Slayer).ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays upon claiming Elvarg's head.}}
You will need to return to [[Edgeville]]; either teleport out, or go through the shortcut and past the [[Deadly red spider|deadly red spiders]], to the south-east of the dungeon where the skeletons are, and climb up the hanging rope to arrive on top of the Karamja volcano.

Talk to [[Oziach]] and the player will inform him that they have slain the dragon. Impressed, Oziach will agree to sell you rune platebodies.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Trivia==
*Although players must complete this quest in order to wear the [[green d'hide body]], its completion is '''not''' required to equip the [[Blue d'hide body|blue]], [[Red d'hide body|red]] and [[Black d'hide body|black]] dragonhide bodies.
*Dragon Slayer I was the last quest to be released before [[Members|membership]] was introduced to ''[[RuneScape Classic]]''.
*When speaking to Oziach at the start of the quest, he asks you how you found out he sells the rune platebody. If you reply 'I am a master detective,' and have completed the [[Murder Mystery]] quest, your character will exclaim that they even solved the Sinclair murder mystery all by themselves.
*If you have completed the quest, when speaking to Duke Horacio during [[The Lost Tribe]] quest, [[Sigmund]] mentions to him that you are the same adventurer who defeated Elvarg. Otherwise Sigmund will reference [[Rune Mysteries]] instead.
*Attempting to take a [[charter ship]] to Crandor, only available during this quest, they will refuse and tell the player "''Crandor? Are you crazy? No charter ship would take you to that island. You'd need to use your own ship, but even then, you'd need a miracle to find a safe route there!''"
*If the player leaves Crandor before defeating Elvarg,  Ned in Draynor Village will answer the player's question how he got back from Crandor with ''"I got towed back by a passing friendly whale."'' When talking to Klarense again, he'll exclaim: ''"Wow! You sure are lucky! Seems the Lady Lumbridge just washed right up into the dock by herself!"'' Miraculously, the ship is not nearly as damaged as after the crash. Only the initial hole in the hull needs fixing once again, requiring the same materials as before (i.e.,  3 planks, 90 steel nails, and a hammer). Ned is standing on the deck just like before, but Cabin boy Jenkins is nowhere to be seen (obviously, since he died during Elvarg's attack on the ship).
*If you sail to Crandor and then teleport out without opening the secret entrance from Karamja to Crandor, the shortcut will unlock by itself.
*Wearing an Amulet of Ghostspeak and talking with the ghosts in Melzar's Maze reveals them to be citizens of Crandor, reliving their final moments before dying.
*If the player has completed [[Pandemonium]], your character will ask the guildmaster if you can captain your own ship. He will suggest finding someone else to be the captain since you will be dealing with a dragon.

==Walkthrough==
===The stone circle===
[[File:Druidic Ritual - Kaqemeex.png|thumb|220px|Speaking to [[Kaqemeex]].]]
{{Needed|recommended=To save time, bring [[raw rat meat]], [[raw bear meat]], [[raw beef]] and [[raw chicken]]. You can read the subsequent section for advice on gathering these.}}
[[File:Kaqemeex chathead.png|left]]
Head to the stone circle on the hill just north of [[Taverley]], immediately east of the road to [[Burthorpe]]. Talk to [[Kaqemeex]] and tell him you are in search of a quest. He will mention that the stone circle south of [[Varrock]] used to belong to the druids of [[Guthix]], but the [[dark wizards]] have cursed the rocks. They are in need of an adventurer to help purify the circle. He asks you to speak to [[Sanfew]], who is working on a purification ritual.

Sanfew can be found to the south, upstairs in the big octagonal [[Herblore shops|Herblore shop]] marked with a herb. Tell him that you were sent to help, and Sanfew will request [[raw rat meat]], [[raw bear meat]], [[raw beef]] and [[raw chicken]], to be dipped in the [[Cauldron of Thunder]] for the ritual.

===Acquiring the meat===
:''Skip this section if you already have the meat.''
[[File:Raw beef detail.png|left|70px|frameless]]
These meats can all be bought on the [[Grand Exchange]], or purchased at [[Rufus' Meat Emporium]] in [[Canifis]] after the completion of [[Priest in Peril]]. 

If obtaining the meat by killing the animals, [[Lands End]] in [[Great Kourend]] has a [[bear]], [[chicken]] and [[rat]] in close vicinity. ({{Map|type=maplink|x=1499|y=3449|mtype=pin|group=kourend}}) You can reach the area via [[Veos]] in [[Port Sarim]] after the completion of [[X Marks the Spot]]. [[Cow]]s can be found south-west of Veos inside the cow field in northern [[Hosidius]]. ({{Map|type=maplink|x=1767|y=3640|mtype=pin|group=kourend}})

Alternatively, there is the [[bear]] near the building just west of [[Ice Mountain]], the [[chicken]] and [[cow]] at the farm just south-east of [[Falador]], and the [[giant rat]] near the graveyard just north of the church below [[Port Sarim]].

===Enchanting the meat===
[[File:Cauldron of Thunder location.png|frame|left|[[Cauldron of Thunder]] location.]]
[[File:Druidic Ritual - Cauldron of Thunder.png|thumb|220px|Enchanting the meats.]]
{{Needed|[[Raw bear meat]], [[Raw rat meat]], [[Raw chicken]] and [[Raw beef]]|recommended=[[Food]] for low levels}}
The [[Cauldron of Thunder]] is located in [[Taverley Dungeon]]. Head south of [[Taverley]] and down the ladder. Head north, past the level 22 and level 25 [[skeleton]]s until you see a gate to the east, with two level 19 [[Suit of armour|suits of armour]] on either side. Try to open the gate and they will attack you (regardless of combat level). Either kill them, or simply continue to click on the gate until it opens. Enchant the meat by using each piece on the [[Cauldron of Thunder]] inside the room, and you will notice they will turn blue.

Once you have enchanted all four meats, return to [[Sanfew]], who will take them and thank the player for bringing the druids one step closer to reclaiming their stone circle. He then asks the player to speak again to [[Kaqemeex]]. Return to Kaqemeex, who will teach the player the basics of the [[Herblore]] skill.

==Walkthrough==
===Starting out===
[[File:Clock Tower - Brother Kojo.png|thumb|220px|Talking to [[Brother Kojo]].]]
[[File:Brother Kojo chathead.png|left|frameless]]
Talk to [[Brother Kojo]] at the [[Clock Tower (building)|Clock Tower]] just south-west of the [[Ardougne Zoo]]. He will tell you that the clock is broken and that you need to find four different coloured [[Cogs (Oaknock's Machine)|cogs]] from the dungeon beneath the tower to fix it.

'''Note:''' Players cannot carry more than one cog at a time, regardless of colour. You will need to retrieve each cog individually and fit it in the right place before moving onto the next one.

===Obtaining the blue cog===
[[File:Clock Tower - Ladder.png|thumb|220px|The ladder, just behind the [[camel]] cage.]]
[[File:Blue cog detail.png|left|60px]]
The [[blue cog]] is locked inside of a cell with a [[dungeon rat]]. 

[[File:Clock Tower - Blue cog.png|thumb|220px|The location of the [[blue cog]].]]
Go outside of the Clock Tower and head north-east to where [[Brother Cedric]] is (from the [[Monk's Friend]] [[quest]]) just south of the [[Ardougne Zoo]]. If you forgot a bucket of water, this is where the bucket and well are. You will notice a ladder just south of the [[camel]] cage from the [[Ardougne Zoo]], around the oak tree.

Go down the ladder and follow the long, winding passage until the end, until you get to a wall that you can push. Push the wall to get inside and pick up the blue cog.

Climb up the ladder in this cage and you'll find yourself south of the [[Clock Tower (building)|Clock Tower]].

Head back inside and climb the stairs to the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} and use the blue cog with the blue spindle.

===Obtaining the black cog===
{{Needed|A [[bucket of water]] or [[ice gloves]].}}
[[File:Black cog detail.png|left|60px]]
[[File:Clock Tower - Black cog.png|thumb|220px|The location of the [[black cog]].]]
This is where the [[bucket of water]] or [[ice gloves]] come in handy. Go inside the [[Clock Tower (building)|clock tower]] and climb down the ladder in the middle room. 

Then head through the passage to the north-east until you see four large coloured tiles on the floor. These tiles will indicate which direction the corresponding coloured cogs are.

Then head through the north-eastern door from the tile room and go as far east as you can until you see several level 2 [[Spider carcass|spiders]].

You will see the [[black cog]] surrounded by short walls of fire. 

To pick up the cog, you may either use the bucket of water with the cog or simply wear your ice gloves. This will cool the cog down so that you can pick it up.

After getting the black cog, head back to the ladder where you first entered, '''but don't go up'''. You should see four spindles near the ladder; use the black cog with the black spindle.

===Obtaining the red cog===
{{Needed|recommended=[[Food]] and [[armour]] for low levels}}
[[File:Red cog detail.png|left|60px]]
[[File:Clock Tower - Red cog.png|thumb|220px|The location of the [[red cog]].]]
Head through the south-eastern door, indicated by the red tile and walk down the passageway until you see some [[Ogre]]s.

The [[red cog]] will be on the floor where the Ogres are. Run over and pick it up then return to the ladder where you came from. 

Climb up to the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} and use the red cog on the red spindle. The spindles are located on a column beside the ground-floor ladder.

===Obtaining the white cog===
[[File:White cog detail.png|left|60px]]
[[File:Clock Tower - White cog.png|thumb|220px|The location of the [[white cog]].]]
Return to the tile room and head through the north-western door, indicated by the white tile and follow the outer passageway until you find some [[rat poison]].

'''Note''': Hop worlds to pick up an extra one if planning to later complete [[Ratcatchers]].

Pick up the poison, then go north-east down the long passageway until you see two levers near the [[dungeon rat]]s. Pull the levers up to open the rat cage. Then head through the two gates and use the poison that you picked up before with the food trough.

The dungeon rats will eat the poisoned food and begin to die. Wait until they've all died, and then you'll find that the gate to the west has become unhinged. Head through the western gate until you find the [[white cog]]. Pick it up and use the ladder nearby to appear outside of the Clock Tower. 

Go inside and climb to the topmost floor. Now, use the white cog with the white spindle on the top floor.

'''Note:''' If you want to keep the cogs as a souvenir, you must reobtain each cog after they have been placed, and before completing the quest. They will not respawn afterwards.

===Finishing up===
Once you've placed all of the cogs on their corresponding spindles, head back to [[Brother Kojo]], and he will reward you.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

{{external|rs=Death Plateau (historical)}}{{otheruses|the quest|the location|Death Plateau (location)}} {{Has quick guide}} {{Infobox Quest |name = Death Plateau |number = 56 |image = [[File:Death Plateau.png|300px]] |release = [[9 August]] [[2004]] |update = Death Plateau Quest |members = Yes |series = [[Quests/Series#Troll|Troll]], #1 |developer = Jonathan S }} '''Death Plateau''' is a short quest wherein you are to help the [[Burthorpe Imperial Guard]] gain access to the [[Death Plateau (location)|Death Plateau]] in order to defeat the hostile [[troll]]s. ==Details== {{Quest details |start = Talk to [[Denulth]] in his tent in [[Burthorpe]]. |startmap = 2896,3528 |difficulty = Novice |length = Short |description = Trolls have come down from the north and are camped on Death Plateau. They are using this base to launch attacks on the principality of Burthorpe! The Imperial Guard is taking heavy losses. They need your help! |members = Yes |items = * 60 [[coins]] (bring 1000 for the gambling dice with Harold part) *10 unnoted [[bread]] *10 unnoted cooked [[trout]] *[[Iron bar]] *[[Asgarnian ale]] (can be found on the bar at the pub in [[Burthorpe]]) |recommended = *[[Premade blurb' sp.]] or [[Blurberry special]] (optional, but strongly recommended, as it trivialises the dice betting segment) *[[Games necklace]] for [[Burthorpe]] teleports or [[Combat bracelet]] for [[Warriors' Guild]] teleports *[[Stamina potion|Stamina]] or [[energy potions]] |ironman = [[File:Ultimate ironman chat badge.png]] Players need 21 empty inventory spaces to deliver items to Tenzing. *A method to obtain an iron bar: **{{SCP|Mining|15}} [[Mining]] and {{SCP|Smithing|15}} [[Smithing]] if smelting [[iron ore]] **Spawn in [[Thurid's Brain Buckets]] on the [[Sunset Coast]] in [[Varlamore]] (requires {{SCP|Quest|[[Children of the Sun]]}}) **Spawn in level 18 [[Wilderness]] north-west of the [[Ferox Enclave]], next to the bears west of the Graveyard of Shadows. Accessible via {{SCP|Minigame|Clan Wars}} [[Minigame Teleport]] **1/42.67 drop from [[dwarf|dwarves]] ({{SCP|Combat|10}}) in the mines under Falador **1/34.42 drop from sorting [[small salvage]] with {{SCP|Sailing|15|link=yes}} |leagueRegion = Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Asgarnia}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Desert}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Fremennik}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest Unlocking {{LeagueRegion|Kandarin}} {{okay}} will auto-complete the quest }} ==Walkthrough== ===Death Plateau=== Head to [[Denulth]], who is located in a tent directly south-east of the [[Warriors' Guild]] in [[Burthorpe]], or south of the [[Burthorpe Games Room]]. He tells you [[troll]]s have taken over the [[Death Plateau (location)|Death Plateau]] and are using it to launch nightly raids. However, they cannot reclaim the camp because the main path is heavily guarded by trolls. It has now become your job to find a different path to the Death Plateau. You also have to open the equipment storage room, which requires a combination code that was lost by the previous night's guard. ===Harold the guard=== {{Needed|[[Asgarnian ale]], 60+ [[coins]], and a [[Blurberry special]] or [[Premade blurb' sp.]] (optional but recommended)}} '''Talk to [[Eohric]]''' on the top floor of [[Burthorpe Castle]]. He will tell you that last night's guard, [[Harold]], is at [[The Toad and Chicken]] pub in [[Burthorpe]]. '''Go to the pub south-east of the castle''', and head upstairs and to the west to find him. '''Try and speak to Harold''', but he doesn't want to talk about the combination. '''Go back and talk to Eohric'''. He will tell you that a beer and gambling may help to make Harold get over his guilt. [[File:Death Plateau - Dice.png|thumb|right|Gambling dice with [[Harold]].]] {{Listen |title = [[Lucky Win (Death Plateau)|Lucky Win]] |align = right |filename = Lucky Win (Death Plateau).ogg |desc = The jingle that plays upon winning against harold.}} {{Listen |title = [[Bad Roll (Death Plateau)|Bad Roll]] |align = right |filename = Bad Roll (Death Plateau).ogg |desc = The jingle that plays upon losing against harold.}} Buy him an [[Asgarnian ale]], or get one from the table downstairs, and try talking to him again. This time, he will tell you he lost the [[combination]] and that he has searched for it everywhere without any success. '''Note:''' ''You can ask Harold if he would like another drink and hand over a [[Blurberry special]] or [[Premade blurb' sp.]], which makes Harold drunk and unable to count. This allows you to automatically win all the dice games as Harold believes you are using all four dice.'' Now, ask him if he wants to gamble. Make sure you have a relatively large stack of coins; you have to continue winning the bets until Harold is out of money, and you may lose a few times. Keep trying to beat him until you get an [[IOU]] (you will only get an IOU betting in amounts between 60 and 1,000 coins). Once you get the IOU, read it to find that the combination code to the storage room is on the back of the [[IOU]]! The [[IOU]] will vanish from your inventory and be replaced with the [[Combination]]. '''Note:''' '''You'll need it at the end but you can get a new IOU (or Combination, depending if you've completed the dialogue from reading the IOU) from Harold if you've lost it. ''' The combination is: {{Cquote2|''Red is north of Blue.
Yellow is south of Purple.
Green is north of Purple.
Blue is west of Yellow.
Purple is east of Red.''}} ===Storage room=== {{Needed|1+ free inventory spaces}} [[File:Death Plateau - Puzzle.png|250px|thumb|right|Combination code to the storage room.]] Head back to the [[Burthorpe Castle|castle]], and you'll see some coloured [[Stone Ball|stone ball]]s on the ground. Pick up the five stones (one of each colour; the yellow ball is just south of the green ball), and place them in this order with the map facing north: *Blue in the bottom left corner. *Yellow in the bottom right corner. *Red in the middle on the left. *Purple in the middle on the right. *Green in the top right corner. '''If you place the balls before reading the IOU/Combination, the door will not open. In this case, pick up one of the balls (Green is closest to door) and replace it after reading the Combination.''' Once you've unlocked the equipment storage room, you can continue on to the next step. ===The new route=== {{Needed|1 free inventory space}} {{Map|mtype=pin|align=right|caption=The map of [[Death Plateau (location)|Death Plateau]]. |2854,3577,title:Saba's Cave,desc: |2820,3555,title:Tenzing the Sherpa,desc: }} Walk out of the [[Burthorpe Castle|castle]] and head north-west, up the path towards [[Death Plateau (location)|Death Plateau]] to find a cave. Go in and talk to [[Saba]]. Ask if he knows of another path to the Death Plateau. The guy has a very rude and grumpy demeanour that may put off anybody, but he hates [[troll]]s as much as those who disturb him, so he will negotiate with you. He proceeds to share with you a secret path from a certain [[Tenzing|Sherpa]]'s house, which leads directly to the Death Plateau. Exit Saba's cave and continue heading west along the path until the path splits into a fork north and south. A wounded soldier marks the dangerous route towards the north. '''{{Colour|red|Warning}}:''' ''If you head north, a warning sign will tell you that Death Plateau is dangerous and you will be attacked by trolls. Do not go this way! Head back south-west.'' Follow the southern path and enter the house; inside you will find the Sherpa [[Tenzing]]. Talk to Tenzing and ask for his help. He will help you in return for 10 [[Loaf of bread|loaves of bread]], and 10 cooked [[trout]]. He will hand you some [[Climbing boots]]. {{Colour|red|Warning:}} If your inventory is full, the climbing boots will not go into your inventory and Tenzing may not sell you another pair. '''Note:''' {{Colour|red|If you have lost your climbing boots}}, continue on with the quest, talk to Dunstan, then talk to Denulth to get the [[certificate]] to accept Dunstan's son into the Imperial troops, then talk to Dunstan again and your character will remark that you have lost the boots. Go back to Tenzing to get another pair. ===Spiked boots=== {{Needed|[[Iron bar]], empty inventory slot and Tenzing's [[climbing boots]]}} Take the [[climbing boots]] to [[Dunstan]] in north-east [[Burthorpe]] (marked by an [[anvil]] on the mini-map, north-east of the castle, you can quickly walk around the castle on the north side) to get them changed into [[spiked boots]]. He tells you that he will make you the boots under one condition: His son should be made into an Imperial Guard. He also requires an [[iron bar]] to make the spiked boots. After talking to Dunstan, head back to the tent where you started the quest, and talk to [[Denulth]], and tell him that you have found a new path. However, it will only be revealed under the condition that the [[Tenzing|Sherpa]] has spiked boots and Dunstan's son be put into the Imperial Guard. Denulth makes an exception and gives you a [[certificate]] to accept Dunstan's son into the Imperial troops. Go back to Dunstan, and speak with him to hand over the iron bar and the certificate to receive a pair of [[spiked boots]]. '''Note:''' If you already have a pair of spiked boots in your bank, Dunstan will not make you another pair and just say "Sorry, I can't do anything with that" when you try to give him an iron bar, he will also hint that you already own a pair. ===Into the mountains=== {{Needed|10 [[Bread|loaves of bread]], 10 [[Trout|cooked trout]], [[combination]], and Tenzing's [[Spiked boots|spiked climbing boots]]}} Go back to [[Tenzing]] and give him his supplies. The bread and trout must be un-[[noted]]! '''Note:''' ''You must give him the 21 items in one go. [[Trout]] can be bought in the [[Warriors' Guild]].'' [[Tenzing]] gives you a [[secret way map|map of the secret area]]. '''You need to check the path before telling [[Denulth]] about it.''' Exit [[Tenzing]]'s house out the side door to his backyard and climb over the [[stile (Death Plateau)|stile]]. Take the path north and then continue following it east. Keep walking until you pass the second [[Mountain Goat]] and the rocks shortcut (don't try to climb the rocks). You may get a popup message saying that you'll be assailed by trolls if you continue while walking along the secret path. Ignore it, as the trolls will only attack if you're on the normal path. Just keep walking east until you get the message that it's safe to tell [[Denulth]] about the secret path. Return to [[Denulth]] with the [[Combination]] and [[Secret way map|secret map]] in your inventory to complete the quest. '''Note:''' ''If the [[Combination]] or the [[Secret way map]] were lost, they can be obtained from [[Harold]] or [[Tenzing]] respectively.'' '''Congratulations, quest complete!''' ==Rewards== {{Quest rewards |name = Death Plateau |image = [[File:Death Plateau reward scroll.png|centre]] |qp = 1 |rewards = *{{SCP|Attack|3,000}} [[Attack]] [[experience]] *[[Steel claws]] *The ability to make [[claws]] *Ability to purchase and wear [[climbing boots]] from [[Tenzing]] }} ==Required for completing== Completion of Death Plateau is required for the following: *[[Troll Stronghold]] ==Transcript== {{Hastranscript|quest}} ==Music== *[[Hermit]] *[[Tremble]] *[[Contest]] ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = |update = |change = Fixed a bug that allowed the rewards for the request to be repeatedly claimed. }} {{Subject changes |date = 8 August 2013 |update = Patch Notes (8 August 2013) |change = Dunstan's dialogue has been adjusted to make it clear if you already have spiked boots in your bank during the Death Plateau quest. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ==Trivia== *[[Tenzing]] is an allusion to the Sherpa {{wp|Tenzing Norgay}}, who, along with the New Zealander {{wp|Sir Edmund Hillary}}, was the first to climb {{wp|Mount Everest}}. *When you open the door to Tenzing's house for the first time, he exclaims 'No milk today! Thank you!' This is probably a reference to the song 'No Milk Today', by the 1960s band, {{wp|Herman's Hermits}}. Coincidentally, the song 'Hermit' is unlocked during the quest. *The idea of a secret path round the back of an invincible army comes from the battle of Thermopylae on which the film ''{{wp|300 (film)|300}}'' was based. *The 3,000 [[Attack]] [[experience]] gained is enough to bring a player from 1 to 16 Attack, which is more than adequate to wield the [[steel claws]] you receive. *If you have a full inventory and are logged out with the boots on the ground they will despawn and you cannot get a new pair. {{Death Plateau}}

==Walkthrough==
===Starting off===
:'''Note:''' If boosting the [[Herblore]] requirement, you will need to boost twice; once before starting the quest, and once before making the [[troll truth potion]].

Speak to [[Sanfew]] on the top floor of the herb shop in [[Taverley]]. Select '''ask general questions''', then ask if he has any more work for you. He will task you to find the secret of the herb [[goutweed]], in order to perform the next part of the purifying ritual on the [[Druid's circle]]. Only the [[troll]]s in the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Troll Stronghold]] know about goutweed, so Sanfew will suggest you speak to his friend, [[Eadgar]], who lives near there at the top of [[Trollheim]].

===Getting to the Troll Stronghold===
{{Needed|[[Food]], [[armour]] and [[climbing boots]]|recommended=An [[Ardougne teleport (tablet)|Ardougne teletab]], [[prayer potion]]s or [[super restore]]s, and one of a [[slayer Ring]], a [[dramen staff]], a [[Ghommal's hilt]], a [[combat bracelet]], or a [[games necklace]]}}

'''''Note:''''' Failing the obstacles, though uncommon, deals 1-5 damage, depending on your current HP.

Make your way to [[Trollheim]] using any of the routes below.

====God Wars Dungeon route====
The fastest and safest method to get to Trollheim is to teleport near the entrance of the [[God Wars Dungeon]] with one of [[Ghommal's hilt]]s, rewarded from completing [[Combat Achievements]]. The hilt's 'Trollheim' option will place the player near the [[Boulder (God Wars Dungeon)|boulder]]/[[little crack]], at which point they may run south to meet up with the thrower troll portion of the Burthorpe route.

====Burthorpe route====
[[File:Eadgar's Ruse - Quest map.png|thumb|240x240px|Shows the various ways to get to Mad Eadgar's Cave. The red line is the path to take if you do not have level 44 agility. Eadgar is located inside the cave entrance.]]
If using a [[games necklace]] or a [[combat bracelet]] teleport to [[Burthorpe Games Room]] or the [[Warriors' Guild]], respectively, and follow the mountain path out of the north-western corner of [[Burthorpe]]. Go south at the fork in the path to [[Tenzing]]'s house. If you don't already have [[climbing boots]], buy some here from Tenzing for 12 [[coins]]. Wear the climbing boots, and climb over the stile in his back yard, following the path north. At the next junction, climb over the rocks, follow the path, and go west at the next fork climbing over rocks as required. Head north to the Secret Entrance that will place you on the lower level of the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Troll Stronghold]].

====Rellekka route====
''If using a [[Slayer ring]] or a [[Dramen staff]], you must have [[climbing boots]] already as you won't be able to reach [[Tenzing]] from this path.''

For the [[Slayer ring]] path, teleport to the [[Fremennik Slayer Dungeon]] or use the [[Fairy ring]] with (code {{Fairycode|ajr}}) to teleport outside the Dungeon entrance. Head north-east to a narrow passage and climb over some rocks ([[climbing boots]] required). Head north to the Secret Entrance that will place you on the lower level of the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Troll Stronghold]].

===Cooking up a plan===
:'''Note:''' If you didn't rescue [[Eadgar]] during the [[Troll Stronghold]] quest, you will need to do so before the following steps, or he will not appear in the cave. You may check the quest log to see whether it says "I've rescued Godric and Mad Eadgar". To rescue him, head to the Stronghold's prison on the bottom level, and pickpocket [[Berry]] the sleeping guard to get the key to his cell. If you are unable to pickpocket him, you may have already freed Eadgar (he will still appear in the cell even after being freed). Unlock the gate to free him.

From the Secret Entrance, head north along the corridor, past the jail cells and sleeping guards and take the stone staircase in the north-east corner. Head south and you'll see four [[Troll Cook]]s here – one of them will be called [[Burntmeat]]. Speak to him, and he will offer to tell you about [[goutweed]] in exchange for a human to cook in his stew.

:'''Tip:''' Consider doing the first section of the [[Troll Romance]] quest while in the area (the three trolls are just to the north-west of the kitchen).

Take the stairs next to Burntmeat and you will be on the upper level of the Stronghold. From here, follow the corridor north until you see the exit on the wall to the east, exit the Stronghold and run south-east to reach the base of [[Trollheim]] on the west side.

At the summit of Trollheim, enter the unmarked cave entrance on the southern side. Speak to Eadgar and the player will inform him of your quest and Burntmeat's request for a human stew. Eadgar has a plan to trick him, but first he needs a parrot.

===The parrot===
{{Needed|[[Climbing boots]], [[vodka]], [[pineapple chunks]], 10 [[grain]], 2 [[logs]], a [[tinderbox]], 5 [[raw chicken]]s, a [[pestle and mortar]], Herblore [[boost]] (if not level 31), and a [[ranarr potion (unf)]]. 10 grain may be picked while obtaining robes from [[Tegid]]|recommended=A [[Slayer ring]] or a [[Dramen staff]] for the fastest access to the troll prison, a [[games necklace]], or a [[combat bracelet]] if not.
A Falador Teleport Tablet if you need to return to Taverley for the dirty clothes}}

Head to the [[Ardougne Zoo]], and talk to [[Parroty Pete]] near the northern [[wolf]] enclosure. Ask him when they added the parrot aviary, and then ask what they like to eat. He will tell you their favourite food is [[pineapple chunks]], and that someone recently replaced their drinking water with [[vodka]] as a prank.

'''Use''' (don't eat) your pineapple chunks on the vodka to make [[alco-chunks]], then use them on the aviary hatch on the west side of the parrot cage. You'll obtain a [[drunk parrot]], with the player telling Parroty Pete that you will take it to the vet.

'''Do not drop''' the parrot or it will fly away. Once you have visited Eadgar with the parrot, you will be able to retrieve it from him if lost.

While in Ardougne, it's also a good idea to pick up your logs, tinderbox, grain, raw chicken, pestle and mortar, and [[unfinished ranarr potion]] from the bank.

Take the parrot to Eadgar. You need to make it look like a human, taste like a human, smell like a human, and talk like a human. (You must do these steps in order; however, you may hand in the items after hiding the parrot.)

:Go back to Eadgar using your route of choice, to talk about the rest of his plan before proceeding to the next step.
:If you pick a Thistle now, you can dry it on a fire on the way back to Eadgar. Scroll down to the [[#Truth serum|truth serum section]] to learn how to acquire a troll thistle.

*'''Talk like a human''' - Go back to the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Troll Stronghold]], and head north through the corridor, then climb down the stone staircase, and unlock the prison door (no key required), finally climb down the second stone staircase to arrive at the prison cells. Go a bit further west and hide your parrot under the rack just north of the cells. Alternatively, use the [[fairy rings]] (code {{Fairycode|ajr}}) or a [[slayer ring]] to teleport to the [[Fremennik Slayer Dungeon]] and follow the north-east passage to the climbable rocks, then open the secret door to the north and you will be directly south of the jail cells. Then, head north until you get to the stone staircase, and then, head west and hide the parrot under the rack north of the cells.
*:You will come back for the parrot later. Make sure that you check your Quest Log and talk to Eadgar before teleporting away.

*'''Look/Taste like a human''' - Teleport out of Trollheim and get your 10 grain, 2 logs, tinderbox, 5 raw chicken, pestle and mortar, and unfinished ranarr potion.
**Note for Ultimate Ironmen: You can make multiple trips with the items if you do not have the inventory space available to bring them in one trip.
*'''Smell like a human''' - Go to [[Taverley]]. You will see [[Tegid]] washing robes in the lake. Talk to him, and ask for a [[dirty robe]]. Then, threaten him with talking to [[Sanfew]] or chopping down trees to get one. After this, if needed, pick 10 [[grain]] just south of Tegid to bring to [[Eadgar]]. Take all items to Eadgar and he will make the human substitute for you. 
**Consider doing the middle sections of the [[Troll Romance]] quest now to save time running back and forth.

===Truth serum===
{{Needed|recommended=Combat gear and supplies for fighting [[Arrg]] if returning to complete the last part of [[Troll Romance]] quest simultaneously}}

'''Note:''' If you boosted your Herblore to start the quest, a level of 31 is needed to make the troll truth potion.  
[[File:Eadgar's Ruse - Troll thistle.png|thumb|220px|A thistle, hiding amongst the grass.]]
After you've done all of this, [[Eadgar]] will tell you that you need to make a [[troll truth potion]] so that [[Burntmeat]] won't lie to you about [[Goutweed]]. Look near the grass patches around Eadgar's hill until you find a tiny [[Thistle (Trollheim)|thistle]] growing in one of them and pick it for a [[Troll thistle]]. It may take you a while, but keep searching. If unable to find it, one may find it helpful to world hop and check the grass directly north or directly west of the cave. The Thistle's name is yellow when displayed at the top-left of the game window.

Once you've found the troll thistle, make a fire with your extra [[log]] and cook it to get a [[dried thistle]]. If you forgot to bring an extra log and/or tinderbox, there is a fire in the cave between the arena and Trollheim. Then, grind it with a [[pestle and mortar]] to make [[ground thistle]]. Finally, [[Greenman's ale|boost]] your Herblore level (if necessary) and add the ground thistle to your [[unfinished ranarr potion]] to make a [[troll potion]]. (If your character doesn't want to, check your quest journal to re-sync your progress).

Talk to Eadgar again. He will take the potion off of you and tell you that the parrot has had enough by now, so you can get it back from the troll jail. At this point it's recommended that you bank and grab some food for the next part of the quest. Go back to the prison cells in the [[Troll Stronghold (location)|Troll Stronghold]], either through the back door to the jail via [[Fairy rings]], code '''{{Fairycode|ajr}}''' or with the [[Slayer ring]] teleport (bring climbing boots). If you chose not to bank, head back to the stronghold then north through the corridor, then climb down the stone staircase, and unlock the prison door. Finally, climb down the second stone staircase to arrive at the prison cells, search the rack to retrieve the parrot, and then return to Eadgar.

After you give the parrot to [[Eadgar]], he will give you the [[Fake man]]. Go back to the cooks in the stronghold by going south of the entrance and then down the stairs, and give the dummy to [[Burntmeat]]. He'll give you a piece of [[burnt meat]] as a reward (which you can discard as it serves no purpose in the quest). He'll also tell you that the [[Goutweed]] is kept in the storeroom and that you can find the key by searching the Kitchen Drawers.
* Consider doing the first section of the [[Troll Romance]] quest if not already previously started. 

Open and then search the stone drawers in the south-eastern corner of the room to find the [[storeroom key]], then go down the stairs just to the north. Down the hallway is a room with patrolling [[Guard (Goutweed)|guards]]. If one of them sees you, it will throw a rock at you, dealing 0-6 damage, and you will be sent back to the entrance. Protection prayers do not block this damage.

The troll guards walk in cycles of 4, repeating. The easiest way to get a Goutweed is to click the crate with the Goutweed with run on as the two guards closest to the door are about to pass each other. Two of the 4 cycles should succeed using this method, and there is a 4 tile window where you can do this. If you get caught the cycle does not change like with [[Sorceress's Garden]] so you can keep trying. If done correctly this should result in a Goutweed every 2 runs. If you prefer you can just click the crate and try to brute force it, players may expect to obtain somewhere in the vicinity of one Goutweed per 5-10 runs using this method. Since you will be running a lot and being thrown out a lot, it is recommended to bring energy-restoring items.

If you wish to utilise the intended mechanics, the best way is to use the two most eastern guards as an indicator of when to move to the second safespot. To do this turn on your run and wait until one of the two guards rounds the northern corner of the boxes that they rotate around. As soon as this happens run to the second safespot. Note that the darker coloured troll patrolling the small section of boxes must also be avoided. Once in the second safespot simply run to the one of the safespots adjacent to the crate when the guard that comes north and closest to you turns west, and then click on the Goutweed crate.

The next way to do this is to use the safespots, which are dead ends surrounded by three crates. Time your movement and run to the first safespot, then wait for your chance to run to the second. You can use the position of the troll guards as an indication of when to move, as the placements of the guards will repeat after one or two cycles. Wait at the second safespot until you get the chance to run to the Goutweed crate and search it. Be careful not to simply click ''search Goutweed Crate'' as this will get you stuck on the sleeping troll instead of going up to the crate. Make sure you click on the spot adjacent to the crate, and ''then'' click search Goutweed crate. You'll be kicked out after you get one piece of Goutweed. Also, if you plan to do [[Dream Mentor]] or [[Dragon Slayer II]] at any point, it is recommended to get two extra Goutweed as it is a required item in those quests ('''Note:''' You can grab multiple Goutweed if you are quick enough to skip the dialogue and click on the crate).

Give the Goutweed to [[Sanfew]] back in Taverley by clicking on the "ask other question" option NOT the "talk about sanfew serum". This will complete the quest.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
===Arrows for the hunt===
[[File:Rantz chathead.png|left]]
{{Needed|[[chisel]], [[axe]], [[knife]], 100 [[feathers]], 4 [[wolf bones]] (or combat equipment to kill level 64 wolves)|recommended=[[food]] for low levels if killing the wolves for the bones|skills={{SCP|Fletching|5}} {{Boostable|yes}} to create [[ogre arrows]]}}
{{Map|name=Rantz|x=2630|y=2981|r=4|width=240|height=240|align=right|mtype=square|caption=The start point of the quest.|group=other}}
Talk to [[Rantz]]; he is located south-east of [[Gu'Tanoth]]. Some ways to get to him include using the [[Gnome glider]] (after completing [[One Small Favour]]), [[Feldip Hills]] [[Feldip hills teleport|teleport]], or the [[fairy ring|Fairy rings]] system ({{Fairycode|AKS}}).

Rantz is hungry and wants you to help him make arrows for his unusually large bow, so he can hunt the [[chompy bird]]. The quest '''must be started by talking to Rantz first''', otherwise you will be unable to make the arrowtips. '''Rantz will not accept the arrows unless you make them yourself.'''

If you didn't bring [[wolf bones]], kill 4 level 64 [[wolves]] in the crater to the south-west of [[Rantz]] and pick up the bones. They may be [[safespotted]] by standing near the roots in the north-east of the swamp.

{{Checklist|
*Use a [[chisel]] on the wolf bones to produce [[wolfbone arrowtips]], and you will receive between 2-6 per bone at random ({{SCP|Fletching|5}}).
*Chop down 4 [[Achey Tree]]s nearby for [[Achey tree logs]].
*Use a [[knife]] on the logs to produce some [[ogre arrow shaft]]s ({{SCP|Fletching|5}}).
*Use [[feather]]s on the [[Ogre arrow shaft|shafts]] to produce [[flighted ogre arrow]]s ({{SCP|Fletching|5}}).
*Use the [[Flighted ogre arrow|arrows]] with the [[wolfbone arrowtips|arrowtips]] ({{SCP|Fletching|5}}).
}}

===The cave===
*Return to [[Rantz]], and give him at least 6 [[Ogre arrow|arrows]]. He then tells you about the [[Swamp Toad|swamp toads]] that his children like to play with.
*Ask Rantz all of the questions that are listed, or else, you won't be able to open the [[Locked Ogre chest|chest]] later.
*Enter the [[Rantz's cave|cave entrance]] north of Rantz.
*Attempt to unlock the  [[Unlocked Ogre chest|chest]]. Unsuccessful attempts will reduce your [[Strength]] by 1.
[[File:Big Chompy Bird Hunting - Opening the Ogre Chest.png|thumb|220px|Opening the chest.]]
*Search the chest to retrieve the bellows (make sure to search it right away, or it may lock again).

===The inflatable toads===
[[File:Big Chompy Bird Hunting - Bloating the toad.png|thumb|220px|Filling the bellows and using it on the toads.]]
*Head to the swamp south-west of [[Rantz]] near the [[wolves]].
*Use the [[bellows]] on the [[swamp bubbles]] in the swamp, at the southern end of the swamp pond. You get three shots with the gas filled bellows before it needs to be filled again. (Swamp bubbles may also be found at [[Yanille Agility dungeon]] near [[poison spider]]s.)
*Use the bellows on a toad again to get a [[bloated toad]], and you will catch it and put it in your inventory. Get three toads. You can only carry a maximum of three bloated toads; inflating more will simply replace one toad in your inventory.

===The chompy and the hunt===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Ranged|30}} {{Boostable|no}} to equip the [[ogre bow]]}}
*Return to [[Rantz]] and talk to him. He will show you where you need to place the toads to lure the [[chompy bird]]s out.

*'''Drop''' some toads on the spot (a yellow flashing arrow will mark it), then walk closer to Rantz. Don't stay too close to the bait, but make sure it is in visible range. On a successful lure, a chompy bird will appear. Occasionally, the lure will be unsuccessful and the bait will disappear; if this happens, drop another toad. Rantz will take a shot at it, but he will miss. He will complain that the arrows don't fly straight.
*Talk to Rantz and offer to help shoot for him. He will agree and give you his [[ogre bow]]. (If you're quick getting the bow, the already spawned chompy bird can be killed. The ogre bow or [[comp ogre bow]] are used during Recipe for Disaster, so be sure to hold on to either if planning to do that quest too).
*Head back down to the clearing and place another toad (it doesn't have to be on the exact tile indicated at first).
*Wield the bow ({{SCP|Ranged|30}}) and arrows and when the bird appears, range it. If the bird doesn't appear or it flies away before you can kill it, keep placing bloated toads to lure the Chompies back.
*Once you kill a Chompy, pluck the carcass and take the [[raw chompy]] back to Rantz. He now wants you to cook it as well. '''In order to progress, you must kill the chompy yourself.''' Purchasing a raw chompy from the [[Grand Exchange]] or another player will not allow you to move forward in the quest.

===Cooking the chompy bird===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Cooking|30}} {{Boostable|yes}} to cook [[raw chompy]]}}

[[Rantz]] will name a special ingredient that he wants the bird to be cooked with. He will also tell you to ask the children what they would like the bird seasoned with.
*Travel to the cave, and ask each of the two Ogre children what they want the [[Chompy]] seasoned with. In all, you will need three different ingredients, but only one bird.
