==Walkthrough==
{{Map|3549,3551|align=right|mtype=square|width=200|height=200|zoom=1|caption=The start point.}}

:'''Note:''' If you are only interested in unlocking access to the [[Experiment Cave]], you do not need any of the required items - follow the Gravedigging section to obtain the star amulet, then skip digging at the grave and go straight to the memorial to enter the cave.

===Job interview===
[[File:Dr Fenkenstrain chathead.png|left|frameless]]
To start the quest, read the [[signpost (Creature of Fenkenstrain)|signpost]] located in [[Canifis]] - it is advertising a job vacancy for a 'Braindead Butler'. If the signpost says you do not meet the requirements, speak to Dr Fenkenstrain directly and he will still offer you the job, allowing you to start the quest.

Pick up the [[pickled brain]] from the table in the pub to the south, and [[Roavar]] the innkeeper will offer to sell it to you for 50 coins. Alternatively, use [[Telekinetic Grab]] to avoid paying.

Follow the path to the north east to [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]], and talk to [[Dr Fenkenstrain]] located just inside. As part of the job interview, he will ask you to describe yourself in one word; answer "braindead", then tell him that your best skill is "grave-digging". He will ask you to find some "dead stuff" - he is planning to stitch together a body and bring it to life. 

The body parts you need to find are the [[pickled brain]] you already picked up, a [[decapitated head]], [[Torso (Creature of Fenkenstrain)|torso]], [[arms]] and [[legs]]; you can retrieve these in any order.

===Gravedigging===
{{Needed|A [[spade]]|recommended=[[Armour]], [[food]], and a [[holy symbol]] is recommended for protection against [[Feral Vampyre]]s and [[leech]]es.}}
{{Map|3608,3491|align=right|mtype=square|width=200|height=200|r=2|caption=[[Gardener Ghost]]'s grave location.}}
[[File:Star amulet detail.png|left|70px|frameless]]
Upstairs in [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]], there are bookcases in both the west and the east rooms. Search the west bookcase for "The Joy of Grave Digging" and you will find a [[marble amulet]]. Search the east bookcase for "Handy Maggot Avoidance Techniques" and you will find an [[obsidian amulet]]. Use them on each other to get a [[star amulet]].

Head to the [[grave (Haunted Woods)|grave]] located slightly south-east of [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|ALQ}} (see map). Using "Read" on the grave will confirm the grave as Ed Lestwit's. Right click to dig the grave, and you will receive a [[decapitated head]]. '''Use the [[pickled brain]] on it'''.
{{Map|3578,3527|align=right|mtype=square|width=200|height=200|r=4|caption=The location of the memorial.}}

Just east of [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]] and west of the Farming patches, there are some tombstones. Use the [[star amulet]] on the furthest [[memorial (Experiment cave)|memorial]] to the east with the indent on it and push it to enter a dungeon that contains unaggressive level 25 and 51 [[Experiment]]s. 

[[File:Experiment safespot.png|thumb|left|200px|Experiment safespot.]]
Kill a level 51 wolf-woman [[Experiment]] to get a [[cavern key]]. An experiment in a crevice to the south west may be [[safespotted]] with ranged or magic, or [[flinched]] with melee by attacking from the crevice entrance.

:'''Note''': If you have started [[Rag and Bone Man II]], you may wish to kill the level 25 experiments here until you receive an [[Experiment bone]].

Once you have the cavern key go through the north-west passage until you reach a gate. Go up the ladder, then dig at the three [[grave (Creature of Fenkenstrain)|grave]]s to the north and you get [[legs]], [[arms]], and a [[torso]].
{{Clear|left}}

===Lightning===
{{Needed|[[Ghostspeak amulet]], [[decapitated head]], [[pickled brain]], [[arms]], [[legs]], [[torso]], [[needle]], 5 [[thread]], 3 [[bronze wire]], and a [[silver bar]].|skills={{SCP|Crafting|20}} {{Boostable|yes}} to create an [[extended brush]]}}
[[File:Creature of Fenkenstrain - The Body.png|thumb|200px|The body after all that trouble.]]
[[File:Creature of Fenkenstrain - repairing conductor.gif|thumb|left|160px|The conductor is repaired.]]
Push the memorial you came out of, and retrace your steps through the cavern. Exit the cavern and follow the path west until you reach [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]].

If you haven't already, use the [[pickled brain]] on the [[decapitated head]], and give the body parts to [[Fenkenstrain]]. He will ask you for a [[needle]] and five spools of [[thread]] to sew the body together. Give them to him, and he will ask you to repair the lightning conductor, so that he may harness the power of lightning to bring the creature to life.
[[File:Creature of Fenkenstrain - Cleaning the Fireplace.png|thumb|200px|Cleaning the Fireplace.]]

Wearing your ghostspeak amulet, ask the [[Gardener Ghost]] in the back of the castle for the [[shed key]], then go inside the shed next to him and search the [[Cupboard (Creature of Fenkenstrain)|cupboard]] for the [[garden brush]].

Take three of the [[garden cane]]s just east of the shed and use them on the brush with the [[bronze wire]] in your inventory ({{SCP|Crafting|20}}). This will create an [[extended brush]], making it suitable for chimney sweeping. Go back inside, take the staircase to the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} and use it on the fireplace in the west room to get a [[conductor mould]]. Make sure you use it on the [[Fireplace (Fenkenstrain's Castle)|centre of the fireplace]] and not the [[fireplace surround]].

Once you have the mould, you need to go to any [[furnace]] with a [[silver bar]] in your inventory to make a [[conductor]] (via the 'make lightning rod' option). The nearest furnace is in [[Port Phasmatys]] (2 ecto-tokens needed to enter, free if [[Ghosts Ahoy]] has been completed). Alternatively, use a teleport to a furnace (such as [[Amulet of glory]] teleport to [[Edgeville]]) if you have a method to easily return to the castle (such as [[fairy ring]] {{fairycode|ALQ}}).

'''Note:''' On some occasions, you cannot make the conductor. Re-logging may fix this issue; in some cases, you have to talk to the gardener to get the option to make the conductor in the furnace.

Go back to [[Fenkenstrain's Castle]]; take the stairs on either the eastern or western side of the castle up to the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}, walk to the room furthest south, and climb the ladder to the roof. Click on the [[lightning conductor]] to fix it. Lightning will instantly strike, and the monster comes to life!

===Lord Rologarth===
{{Needed|skills={{SCP|Thieving|25}} {{Boostable|yes}} to pickpocket Dr Fenkenstrain}}
[[File:Creature of Fenkenstrain - He Lives!.png|thumb|200px|It's alive! ...and it talks!]]
[[File:Lord Rologarth chathead.png|left|frameless]]

Talk to [[Dr Fenkenstrain]] again. He will tell you that the monster tried to kill him, so he locked it in the tower. He will give you the [[tower key]] and tell you to kill the monster. Go upstairs again, and enter the central room of the upstairs section, climb the ladder, and talk to Fenkenstrain's monster.

The monster will introduce himself as [[Lord Rologarth]]. He will tell you the true story of how Fenkenstrain tricked him into selling all of his subjects and himself to the [[vampyre]]s, and ask you to stop him from carrying out any more experiments. Talking to Rologarth again will reveal that the [[Ring of Charos]] allows Fenkenstrain to raise the dead from their sleep. The ring additionally confuses the werewolves' senses, making them believe that they smell one of their own kind.

You will need to steal the ring from him in order to leave Fenkenstrain at the mercy of the werewolves. Go back downstairs and pickpocket him to obtain it ({{SCP|Thieving|25}}).

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Walkthrough==
{{Map|2731,3713|mtype=pin|align=right|caption=The cave entrance to Keldagrim.}}

===Don's rock===
{{Needed|4 [[coins]] or a [[Ring of Charos(a)]]|recommended=Teleport to [[Falador]] or the [[Edgeville Monastery|Monastery]]}}

Start the quest by going to the [[Keldagrim]] mines north-east to [[Rellekka]]. You can get there in several different ways:

* [[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|dks}}, which can be found north-east of [[Rellekka]]. 
* You can use the [[enchanted lyre]] for easy access, or, if your house is in Rellekka, you can also teleport there. 
* Take the [[Keldagrim minecart system|minecart]] from the [[Grand Exchange]]. If doing so, go north-west from the carts to the [[Dwarven Boatman]] and take the boat (free) to reach the ferryman at the entrance.

Once you've entered the cave, there will be a crack between two dwarf statues directly across from you, which you should enter. From there, talk to the [[Dwarven Ferryman]] ('''not the boatman''') for a ride across the river, which will cost 2 [[coins]] or be free if you have a [[Ring of Charos(a)]] equipped.

Go east and around the rock wall and then go west until you reach and cross the bridge that leads to [[Dondakan the Dwarf|Dondakan]]'s Rock and his [[Dwarf Multicannon]]. 

Speak to [[Dondakan]]. Ask ''"Why are you firing a cannon at a wall?"'' to begin the quest, then speak to him again and ask ''"So why were you trying to get through the rock again?"''.

[[File:Keldagrim map.png|thumb|244x244px|The dwarven boatman and ferryman are south of the River Kelda at the docks. Dondakan can be reached via the ferryman and going north.]]Dondakan will then ask you to get further information about the rock and tell you to talk to the Librarian. Return to the other side of the river, paying 2 coins again or crossing for free with the ring. This time, speak with the '''Boatman''' to be taken to Keldagrim. If you have not started [[The Giant Dwarf]], you will be presented with a small cutscene introducing the area. You will then be taken by guards, giving you the option to start The Giant Dwarf.

You can talk to the Librarian on the Western side of Keldagrim, but it won't do much other than specifying who to speak with. Instead, go into the western part of the [[Trading Consortium]]. Look for the area with an [[anvil]] on the minimap in the palace and speak with the [[Dwarven Engineer|engineer]] inside of the room it's located in. This is located within the large building '''not''' the anvil which is further west.

You will be told to speak with [[Rolad]] located in the eastern building at the [[Dwarven Mine]] entrance camp next to [[Ice Mountain]]. To get there, either teleport to [[Falador]] or the [[Edgeville Monastery|Monastery]] and walk the distance, use [[Ancient Magicks]] to teleport to Lassar, teleport to the [[Barbarian Village]] with a [[skull sceptre]], or take the mine carts located in the south-eastern portion of Keldagrim for 150 coins (75 coins if you have the [[Ring of Charos(a)]]). If you took the carts, head south, east, then north and exit the mine.

Rolad is inside the eastern house at the camp. He will ask you to find the pages from a book giving you information about the rock.

:'''Note:''' Make sure to fully complete the dialogue otherwise the pages won't appear.

=== Between the pages ===
{{Needed|A pickaxe, 1 gold bar (an extra 1 if you want your own golden cannonball), and 3 inventory slots, ammo mould.|recommended=A weapon and food to kill a level 14 [[Scorpion]], and a teleport to a furnace (see below for some).}}

All three pages can be obtained in the [[Dwarven Mine]] in any order. Note that the pages may require multiple attempts to be obtained:

# The [[Book page 1|first page]] can be found by killing [[scorpion]]s in the south-eastern area of the mines. (It may take a few kills) (Try switching worlds if killing a scorpion doesn't give you page 1)
#* '''Tip:''' Squeeze through the narrow crevice (level 42 Agility) to complete a [[Medium Falador Diary|medium Falador diary]] task when returning to Rolad from the SE area of the mine.
# The [[Book page 2|second page]] can be found by searching the mine carts along the tracks.
# The [[Book page 3|third page]] can be found by mining [[Clay rocks|clay]], [[Copper rocks|copper]], [[Tin rocks|tin]], or [[iron rocks]] inside the mine.

Return to Rolad when you have found all three [[pages]], and he will give you the [[Dwarven lore]]. 

Rolad will ask you to give back the book because he wants to study it. You can answer '''"Of course"''' or '''"Of course. (lie)"''' Choose to lie and read the book, and '''keep it for later'''. If you need an [[ammo mould]], purchase it from [[Nulodion]] in the western house next door to Rolad.

Head back to Dondakan using one of the methods first used to reach him and speak with him until you get a short cutscene where he kicks the rock to no avail. He then tells you that he wants a material that is stronger than [[runite]] and [[granite]]. This is where your [[gold bar]]s come in handy. Show him your gold bar by using it on him.

:'''Note:''' You can also show him a [[gold ore]] instead. If you have forgotten to bring one, there is a [[gold vein]] in the cave south of Dondakan's.

Go to any [[furnace]] with a gold bar and your cannonball ammo mould, and make a [[Cannon ball (Between a Rock...)|golden cannonball]] by using the gold bar on the furnace. Some furnaces include:
* Falador's furnace is just a few steps away using [[Falador Teleport]].
* Edgeville's furnace can quickly be reached using an [[amulet of glory]] or using the [[Minigame Teleport]] to [[Soul Wars]] and exiting the yellow portal.
* Completion of [[Lost City]] lets you use the furnace at [[Zanaris]], and partial completion of [[Fairytale II - Cure a Queen|Fairytale II]] lets you take the fairy ring {{Fairycode|DKR}} to Edgeville.
* If you have completed [[The Fremennik Trials]], Rellekka's furnace is the fastest on foot; but teleporting is much quicker.
* You can also walk back to the mine carts in SE Keldagrim, take Cart 3 to the Grand Exchange, then use the shortcut from the Grand Exchange to Edgeville (21 [[Agility]]).

'''Tip:'''  If you want a trophy golden cannonball in your bank, make one and drop it, make another, then [[Telekinetic Grab|telegrab]] the one on the floor. Trying to pick one up normally won't work if you have another on you.

When you are finished, return to Dondakan and give him the golden cannonball by using it on him. When he fires it, the cannonball will disappear through the wall. He will then ask to fire '''you''' through the wall, but he needs the schematics in order to change the cannon to be able to fire a human. You will also need to make yourself a [[gold helmet]] (requires 50 Smithing) if you don't want your head to explode when you hit the wall.

:'''Tip:''' Smithing a golden helmet in the [[Resource Area]] is a medium [[Wilderness Diary]] task.

=== Breakthrough design ===
{{Needed|3 gold bars (an extra 3 if you want your own golden helmet) and a hammer.|recommended=Teleport to Camelot or Games necklace or 100 coins.}}
{{Listen
|title = [[Making Sense of Dwarven Schematics (Between a Rock)|Making Sense of Dwarven Schematics]]
|align = right
|filename = Making Sense of Dwarven Schematics (Between a Rock).ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays upon solving the schematic.}}
There are a set of four (4) schematics:

# The first [[Schematic (Dondakan)|schematic]] is given to you by Dondakan.
# The [[Schematics (Dwarf Engineer)|second one]] is given by the engineer you spoke to earlier back in Keldagrim, by the anvil in the western palace bottom floor. 
#* Before moving on, you can make your [[Gold helmet|golden helmet]] by the anvil. The helmet is extremely heavy, so it's a good idea to put it in the bank. '''Tip:'''  If you want to have more than one [[Gold helmet|golden helmet]] after the quest, make one and drop it, make another, then [[Telekinetic Grab|telegrab]] the one on the floor. This helmet is useful for slaying [[gryphons]] and the [[Shellbane gryphon]] boss, as they have a special attack that is blocked by having a high equipped weight.
# Read to the last page of the Dwarven lore book, and you will find another [[Base schematics|schematic page]].
# Enter the [[White Wolf Tunnel]]; it can be reached easily by using [[Camelot Teleport]] and walking down the stairs to the east, or teleporting to [[Burthorpe Games Room]] ([[Minigame Teleport]] / [[games necklace]]) and walking down the stairs to the south of Burthorpe. Go to the small bar area, and speak with [[Khorvak]]. He will ask for a [[dwarven stout]]. You can take one off the table and give it to him by using it on him, or refuse and enjoy a funny piece of dialogue about ''RuneScape'' and alcoholics. Either way, you will receive the [[Schematics (Khorvak)|final schematic]].

Once you have all schematics, click 'assemble' on the one Dondakan gave you. You will be shown all schematics, but they will not make any sense. What you must do here is move the schematics one by one so that they fit with the original schematic. Select and show one at a time, rotate and move them to fit. It may be easiest to use the human stick figure legs, torso, and head to position each of the pieces correctly. This part should be quite simple. Be aware that even if you move the pieces in the correct relative position, you might need to select them all and move them together to the correct position on the screen. Once you put them all in place, the screen will show: ''"That's it! It all makes sense now! If you were a dwarf, that is..."''.[[File:Between a Rock... schematics.png|frame|centre]]

===Riddle of the Rock===
[[File:Between a Rock... open fire.png|thumb|220px|... Too late!]]
{{Needed|A weapon, armour and food to defeat a level 75-125 enemy; golden helmet (equipped), a pickaxe, and 2 coins or [[Ring of Charos(a)]] for ferry.|recommended=15 free spaces in your inventory.}}

Once the schematic is assembled, return to Dondakan.

To fight the [[Arzinian Being of Bordanzan]], you will need to mine at least six 6 [[gold ore]]. Otherwise, it will keep regenerating its hitpoints. ''Mining 15 pieces of gold is highly recommended as this will lower the combat level of the boss from 125 to 75.'' '''The gold must remain in your inventory.''' '''You only have eight 8 minutes to mine the gold AND defeat the avatar; if you take off your gold helmet, you will be teleported back to Dondakan.'''

'''Note:''' Mining a gold rock here will grant you the achievement for the [[Medium Fremennik Diary]]. You will not need to revisit the mine after the quest.
Equip the golden helmet; make sure you have a pickaxe because '''any gold ore/ingots in your inventory will disappear'''. Go back to Dondakan with the schematics and the items needed to kill the level 75-125 enemy. Once you are ready, ask Dondakan to shoot you into the rock.

[[File:Between a Rock... fighting arzinian avatar.png|thumb|220px|left|Fighting the Arzinian Avatar]]
When you feel you have enough gold ore, go to the centre of the area, where you will find a set of flames. Go through the first set of flames and talk to the second set. While talking to the flames, the [[Arzinian Avatar]] will attack.

The avatar will appear in one of three forms for the duration of the fight. The form chosen is usually based on your highest combat stat, though there is additionally a small chance to instead pick another form. The form that appears will determine the attack style of the boss:

*[[Arzinian Avatar of Magic]] if your highest combat stat is [[Strength]] or [[Attack]].
*[[Arzinian Avatar of Ranging]] if your highest combat stat is [[Magic]].
*[[Arzinian Avatar of Strength]] if your highest combat stat is [[Ranged]]. 

Choose combat equipment and prayers accordingly. See [[Arzinian Avatar]] for more details.

You can use [[Prayer]] for an easy fight; the spirit shouldn't take too long to kill. If you are close to dying, you can take your gold helmet off, which will teleport you outside of the rock, next to Dondakan.

'''Tip''': If you die then collect the helmet from the ground and enter the cave again. You will have to start over. <u>Remember food.</u>

When you have defeated the spirit, you will be teleported back out of the rock. Speak to Dondakan to finish the quest. 

'''Note:''' If your inventory was full when defeating the boss the helmet will be dropped on the ground.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

'''Tip''': If you plan on obtaining the [[Music cape]], re-enter the mine to unlock the song [[In Between]].

==Trivia==
*If the [['perfect' gold bar]] from the quest [[Family Crest]] is offered to Dondakan to make cannonballs from, he will tell players "Perfect gold? That's much too valuable to be used to make cannonballs!"
*After the quest, you may attempt to make an offer to buy Dondakan's [[Granite boots]], but no matter how much you offer, he will never sell them.
*You can easily see 3 rooms used for Temple Knight initiation in [[Recruitment Drive]] from where you enter the rock.
*You have an option to respond to Dondakan when you are ready to be fired through the wall with "you may fire when ready!" which is a ''{{wp|Star Wars: Episode IV – A New Hope}}'' reference.
*The part of the quest where the player gets launched with a rocket to the fight might be a reference to the 1902 adventure film ''{{wp|A Trip to the Moon}}'' by Georges Méliès.
*As of {{CURRENTDAY}} {{CURRENTMONTHNAME}} {{CURRENTYEAR}}, if Dondakan's cannon has been firing at the wall every 4 game-ticks since the quest released, he has spent approximately {{Coins|{{GEP|Steel cannonball|({{#time:U|today}} - {{#time:U|21 March 2005}}) / 0.6 / 4 round 0}}}} on steel cannonballs.
*Between a Rock... was released months before Keldagrim was opened to players. Prior to the city's unveiling, the [[Dwarven Engineer]] could be found in the [[Dwarven Mine]] below [[White Wolf Mountain]].
*The name of the quest is a reference to the saying "between a rock and a hard place", which means "faced with two equally undesirable alternatives".
*Completion of this quest will cause a [[Crazy penguin|penguin cannonball]] to spawn during and after the quest [[Cold War]]. ==Introduction==
Desert Treasure is one of ''[[Old School RuneScape]]''{{'}}s most well-known quests, and is commonly completed by [[player killers]] for its reward of the [[Ancient Magicks]]. Due to the difficulty of the quest's bosses, players are '''highly advised''' to read through each section before starting the fights, as each boss has unique fight mechanics that heavily favour certain combat styles, including immunity to specific spells. [[Pures]] wishing to avoid gaining [[Hitpoints]] experience should note that all of the bosses may be defeated with the help of a [[Dwarf multicannon|cannon]], but should be prepared to use 500 or more [[Cannonball|cannonballs]] due to the high amount of combat throughout the quest. See the "notes for pures" section under each boss for more information.

==== Stranger Danger ====
Before starting, note that if you're carrying one or more of the [[Diamonds of Azzanadra]], you may be attacked by a level 95 [[Stranger]] who appears next to you and carries a [[poison]]ed [[dragon dagger]]. This is random and does not happen to everyone, but can happen at any point where the diamonds are in your inventory.

To be safe, players may want to carry a [[teleport]] and [[antipoison]] when moving the diamonds and ensure having some spare [[prayer point]]s until the quest is completed. Players can flee from him when he appears. Simply banking the diamonds will prevent him from appearing further, but players should be warned that he can strike almost immediately after the diamonds are received from their respective bosses. Make sure to close the bank interface, you can still be attacked after banking the diamond if the interface is still open.

[[Ultimate ironmen]] can deposit each diamond into the pyramid as they acquire them so as not to risk attack; see the [[Desert Treasure I#The Ancient Pyramid|Ancient Pyramid section]] below for more information.

Bring Eblis the items required. Make sure to '''use''' the bones on him instead of burying them, noting them will avoid this.

After giving him the items, Eblis will have travelled south-east on top of a hill (shown as a grey circle on the minimap), surrounded by six mirrors. Looking into them will show locations related to the diamonds, though it is not required.

'''Diamonds can be acquired in any order. The order below is sorted from easiest to hardest.'''

==Smoke diamond==
{{Needed|[[Shantay pass (item)|Shantay pass]]es, [[waterskins]], a [[tinderbox]] ([[Bruma torch]] does not work); a gas mask, face mask, or slayer helmet; two or more [[Energy potion]]s or a [[stamina potion]], [[ice gloves]] or [[water spell]] [[runes]] (staves do not work without [[ice gloves]]), [[prayer potion]]s, a [[weapon]] (only if wearing [[ice gloves]]; otherwise your weapon will be unequipped), [[armour]] (Magic-defence armour or armour with [[Prayer bonus]]), [[food]], and an emergency teleport.}}[[Fareed]] is widely considered the easiest boss of the quest, due to the fact that he uses [[melee]] almost exclusively. Keep the following in mind during this section:

* Those coming directly from the [[ice diamond]] section must restore their [[Firemaking]], as the [[Standing Torch (Smoke Dungeon)|torches]] require at least level 50 Firemaking to light.
* A [[facemask]], [[slayer helmet]], or a [[gas mask]] '''must''' be worn at all times while in the dungeon, or the player will be hit for 20 damage every 12 seconds. While this smoke effect won't kill you (it will never damage you below 1 hitpoint), various monsters can still deal damage, posing a significant risk for low-level players should they accidentally enter combat.
{{Map|name=Smoke Dungeon|x=3310|y=2962|r=4|mtype=square|align=right|caption=The [[Smoke Dungeon]] is located west of [[Pollnivneach]].|width=250|height=250}}

===With gate responsibility===
[[File:Smoke Dungeon map.png|center|thumb|500px|A map of the [[Smoke Dungeon|dungeon]].]]

Take all of the items listed above and travel to the [[Smoke Dungeon]]. The dungeon entrance is marked on the world map; hug the cliffs on the west side of [[Pollnivneach]], and head south to find it. Climb down the well, and if it stops you with a warning about the air inside, just try to climb down again. 

In each of the four corners of the dungeon are [[Standing Torch (Smoke Dungeon)|standing torches]] that you need to light using your [[tinderbox]] ([[Bruma torch]] does not work).  '''The torches will burn out if you take too long;''' if you walk instead of run, the first lamp will have burnt out by the time you reach the [[burnt chest]]. As such, it is recommended to use [[energy potion]]s or [[stamina potion]]s to maintain run energy.

While the torches can be lit in any order, it's recommended to start with the north-eastern torch, as it's the farthest from the chest. From there, the torches can be lit in under two minutes if running to the south-eastern torch second, the north-western torch third, and finishing at the south-west torch, allowing you to quickly run to the chest. 

When all four are lit, go to the centre of the dungeon and open the burnt chest to obtain the [[warm key]]. ''If the key is lost before being used to unlock the gate, it can be reobtained from the chest without needing to relight the torches.''

===Facing Fareed===
Make your way to the east part of the dungeon and use the key on the gate to begin the fight with [[Fareed]].

''If you leave the fight before killing Fareed, you will '''NOT''' need to get the Warm Key again.''[[File:Desert Treasure torch.png|thumb|The torch the player needs to light.]]

====The fight====
[[File:Fighting Fareed.png|thumb|right|A player fighting [[Fareed]].]]

* Despite his simplicity, [[Fareed]] should not be underestimated. His main attack is a melee hit that can deal up to 40 damage (or 36 with ice gloves). [[Protect from Melee]] negates all damage from his melee attack; those with low [[Hitpoints]] who do not have 43 [[Prayer]] should ensure they are not in melee range.
*Fareed also has a [[Magic]] attack, but it can only be cast in melee distance. While it's very uncommon for him to use the attack, it can still hit in the 20s, so [[Armour/Magic armour|Magic defence]] is recommended to supplement melee protection prayers.
*If the player doesn't have [[ice gloves]] equipped, Fareed will repeatedly remove the player's weapon to their [[inventory]]. This makes melee impossible for those without the gloves; combined with his high melee defence, and his ability to hit with magic while in melee range, melee is not recommended when fighting him.
*'''Magic is the most effective attack style''', as Fareed is very weak to [[water spells]]. Mages should note that any other spell type will '''not''' work against him, including [[God spells]] and the [[trident of the seas]] and [[Trident of the Swamp|swamp]]. Players can bypass the need for ice gloves by manually casting spells from their spellbook.
*Range is also fairly effective; although as before, ice gloves are required to wield a bow around him when in melee distance. It may be advisable to use cheap ammunition on Fareed, as any ammunition used besides [[ice arrows]] will drop beneath him as [[ashes]], bypassing the ammo-saving effect of [[Ava's accumulator]] and [[Ava's assembler]].
*[[Bind]], [[snare]], or [[entangle]] can be used to stop him from moving, though moving too far out of range will cause him to despawn. Using the technique of binding him and running away (known as [[kiting]]), players can avoid the need for prayer or ice gloves by preventing him from ever getting in melee distance.
*Fareed can also be trapped and safespotted behind another player. The [[dwarf multicannon]] works in the dungeon.

Upon defeating Fareed, the [[Smoke diamond]] will appear in your inventory. If lost, it will reappear in the chamber on the ground when the player walks through the gate. Fareed will not have to be fought again.

==Shadow diamond==
{{Needed|[[Shantay pass (item)|Shantay pass]]es, [[waterskin]]s, 20—100+ [[lockpick]]s, noted lockpicks and 5 [[coins]] per to exchange at [[Tiles]]|recommended=Teleportation method to [[Rasolo]] ([[skills necklace]] to teleport to the [[Fishing Guild]], [[games necklace]] to [[Barbarian Outpost]], or [[Barbarian Assault]] [[Minigame Teleport]]), teleport method to [[Al Kharid]] ([[amulet of glory]] or [[ring of dueling]]), multiple [[antipoison]], [[super restore]] if using melee, [[food]]. Additional noted supplies may be preferable.}}

Damis is similar to Fareed in that he uses melee and can be easily safespotted. While the fight is fairly straightforward, his section is one of the longest, so keep the following in mind to avoid multiple trips, and ensure a successful fight:

*[[Rasolo]] '''must''' be spoken to before the chest can be [[Lockpick|picked]] open.
*There is a large amount of running for this section, making stamina or restore potions beneficial.
* Contrary to popular belief, Damis is not particularly weak to earth spells.

===Giving a ring===
[[File:Desert Treasure Rasolo.png|thumb|Talking to Rasolo in the location shown by the mirror.]]
Travel west of the [[Fishing Guild]] to the entrance of the [[Tourist Information Centre]]. Just east of the Tourist Information Centre lies a fenced area, with a wandering man named [[Rasolo]] nearby. Talk to Rasolo, asking about the diamonds, and he'll offer to give you a [[ring of visibility]] in exchange for a [[gilded cross]].

[[File:Desert Treasure chest.png|thumb|The chest the player needs to open.]]
Take some [[food]], [[lockpick]]s, and [[antipoison]] to the [[Bandit Camp (Kharidian Desert)|Bandit Camp]]; for ironmen, note that both lockpicks and antipoisons may be pickpocketed from the [[Bandit (Bandit Camp)|Bandits]] in the vicinity. In the southern-most tent in the Bandit Camp is a [[secure chest]], requiring 53 [[Thieving]] to open. Use lockpicks on it until all 3 locks are bypassed, and the chest is opened; then, search the open chest to receive the gilded cross and 150 Thieving [[experience]]. 

This section is straightforward, but many players find this section to be tedious and require many tries. If a player fails to open any of the locks, all of the previous locks are reset, and the player's lockpick will break. Each failed attempt will deal 2—3 damage, as well as have a chance to apply [[poison]] to the player if not protected. For those who find themselves running out of food or lockpicks, the nearby [[Tiles]] will un-note additional supplies 5 coins each, allowing players to bring larger stacks of items.

If the cross is lost, search the chest again to receive a new one; it does not need to be re-picked.

===Defeating Damis===
{{Needed|[[Gilded cross]]|recommended=Combat equipment, [[prayer potion]]s, [[runes]] to cast spells such as [[Entangle]], [[stamina potion]]s, and an emergency teleport.}}

{|
|colspan=2|[[File:Shadow Dungeon map.png|center|thumb|500px|[[Shadow Dungeon]]]]
|-
|1. Entrance east of [[Baxtorian Falls]] with [[ring of visibility]]||G – [[Giant skeleton (Shadow Dungeon)|Giant skeletons]] ''(level 80)''
|-
|2. [[Damis]]||S – [[Shadow hound]]s ''(level 63)''
|}

Return to Rasolo and exchange the gilded cross for the [[ring of visibility]]. Equip the ring, and a ladder will appear to the east of Rasolo in the fenced area. Climb down the ladder, then head east as far as you can, then north as far as you can. Head east again, and go south as far as possible at the first fork. Go east again. After this, take the next turn north, then go east, and you will reach [[Damis]]' cave. Beware that the area where [[Damis]] is encountered is a [[multi-combat area]], filled with [[Giant skeleton (Shadow Dungeon)|giant skeletons]] and [[shadow hound]]s. These monsters solely use melee, so activating [[Protect from Melee]] will negate all damage.

Once Damis' cave is reached, it's time for the fight. If he does not spawn, players can make Damis appear by running around a bit in the final area. You must have the ring of visibility equipped or he will not appear; make sure to '''keep the ring equipped for the entire fight'''. 

'''Note:''' It is possible for Damis to not appear right away. Un-equipping and re-equipping the ring of visibility may help, as well as walking around the arena close to the walls. If he still doesn't appear, hopping worlds should work. 

If you teleport out after defeating him without picking up the diamond, it will remain on the ground and you can come back to pick it up, without having to fight him again. Additionally, players may find it beneficial to kill a shadow hound while in the dungeon, to complete a task for the [[Hard Kandarin Diary]].

====The fight====
[[File:Fighting Damis.png|thumb|A player fights [[Damis]].]]
* Damis has two forms. The first is level 103 which only attacks with [[Melee]], and the second form is level 174 and rapidly drains [[Prayer]] when attacking you. The second form is significantly harder, and has an attack speed of 3, as well as being able to hit up to 28 while draining 5% + 1 of your current Prayer points every [[tick]] (0.6 seconds).
** At 43 prayer, this attack will drain 3 prayer points every tick. Combined with normal rate of prayer drain, this means that players will lose 16 points every three seconds.
** This prayer drain only triggers when Damis is in melee distance; safespotting him allows players to ignore this mechanic completely.
** With Protect from Melee, [[Damis]] is not much more difficult than any other monster, although you'll need to ensure you have enough prayer potions to account for his prayer drain. Make sure to watch your prayer points so that you don't run out.
* The most common way of defeating Damis is with magic. While it is possible to use Melee, his Melee defence is very high, on top of subjecting players to the prayer drain.
* Damis has no elemental weakness;{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1028980496020242432|date=13 August 2018|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/99559|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=The ice & fire warriors have effects. So do mummies in the pyramid. That's all I could find.}} any spell will suffice. You can use a [[trident of the seas]] for both forms.
* Unless safespotting, you will rely heavily on [[Protect from Melee]], as without it activated, you'll be tanking 2-4 [[Giant skeleton (Shadow Dungeon)|giant skeletons]] and [[shadow hound]]s while trying to kill [[Damis]], all of whom attack accurately with Melee.
* Without Protect from Melee, prepare to take large amounts of damage '''very''' quickly. To simply tank Damis without using prayer potions, it is recommended to have level 65 to 70 melee stats at minimum, a [[divine super combat potion]], and a full inventory of high-healing food ([[Cooked karambwan|karambwan]] or better). Poisoning Damis is also helpful.
* If you leave after defeating his first form, you do not have to fight it again! When you return, you will only have to defeat his second form, allowing players to re-supply if necessary.
* Bringing a [[stamina potion]] and kiting him around the arena will help reduce the burden of using [[prayer potion]]s. Casting [[Snare]]/[[Entangle]] on [[Damis]] and re-casting once he moves can help keep him from ever coming within Melee distance.[[File:Desert treasure safespot.png|thumb|220px|A player uses a [[giant rat]] to [[Safespot]] [[Damis]].]]

====Notes for pures====
* If you plan to use the [[Safespot]], lure his first form there, as otherwise, his second form will just disappear into the shadows.
* The safespot is easy to set up: as soon as Damis spawns, head to the safespot, using the torches to your advantage (Note: this is only a flinch method, not a true safespot)
* Due to the dungeon being multicombat, '''it is recommended''' to use creatures, such as the rat or the [[bat]] found around the north-east safespot of the arena. To do so, simply position yourself behind the animal and attack it with a weak attack or spell, then attack Damis with Magic or Range. Consider bringing a fun weapon such as flowers to draw the creatures' attention without killing it. You may also use the thin tunnel if luring Damis to the torch seems ineffective. If using the tunnel, 43 Prayer and/or high-healing food is recommended as a [[Giant Skeleton]] will continuously spawn in the NE opening.
* You can also poison Damis, and then use the safespotting method to let the poison lower his health; he rarely despawns.
* Cannons can be set up in this area. For those without access to prayer, the south-eastern-most area of the dungeon is just wide enough to fit a cannon, but narrow enough to trap Damis while setting it up.

Once you have defeated Damis in his second form, he will drop the shadow diamond on the ground. Once the diamond is in players' inventories, they can safely teleport out of the dungeon. If the diamond is lost, simply crossing the corridor into the multi-combat zone, the area where Damis spawns, will make the diamond reappear on the ground.

==Blood diamond==
{{Needed|[[Garlic powder]] (created by using your [[pestle and mortar]] with [[garlic]]), [[silver bar]], [[spice]].|recommended=Good food ([[swordfish]] or better), 1-2 [[prayer potion]]s, [[Druid pouch|druid pouches]], and a [[Draynor Village|Draynor]] teleport method.}}

[[Dessous]] is a fairly straightforward boss, but due to his location, forgetting steps can cost a lot of time. Keep the following in mind:

* The pot cannot be made ahead of time,  you need to get instructions from [[Malak]] first.
* Save gearing up until after you get the [[Silver pot (Desert Treasure I)|silver pot]], as you'll need to go to [[Entrana]] to get it blessed, and combat items aren't allowed on the island.
* If you plan on using the [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)|Shades of Mort'ton]] [[Minigame Teleport]] and [[Swamp Boaty|the Hollows boat]], make sure to bring 10 coins or a [[Ring of Charos(a)]] for the ride.

===Sweetening the pot===
[[File:Desert Treasure talking to Malak.png|thumb|Malak notices your presence whilst collecting blood tithes.]]
Travel to [[Canifis]] ([[fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|cks}}), and talk to [[Malak]] in the pub. Tell him that you're looking for a diamond. He'll agree to give it to you if you kill Dessous and gives you a list of items that you'll need to kill him successfully. '''Make sure to ask [[Malak]] how to kill [[Dessous]] before you go to [[Ruantun]] or he won't make the silver pot for you.''' Travel to [[Draynor]], there is [[garlic]] in the cupboard upstairs in [[Morgan]]'s house if you need it. Bring your [[silver bar]] down the trapdoor, west of Morgan's house, to enter [[Draynor Sewers]]. In the sewers, go east, then north and talk to [[Ruantun]]. Ask him to make you a [[Silver pot (Desert Treasure I)|silver pot]]. 

Take the pot to [[Entrana]] (making sure you have no [[weapons]]/[[armour]] on you; there's a deposit box at the ship that can be used to bank before embarking), and head to the church, then use the silver pot on the [[High Priest (Entrana)|High Priest]] to get it blessed. Go back to Canifis, and talk to Malak again and he'll fill the pot with your blood (this will damage you for 5 [[Hitpoints]], but '''cannot''' kill you). Finally, add the [[garlic powder]] to the pot along with some [[spice]] to prepare for the battle. The [[High Priest (Entrana)|High Priest]] will still bless a silver pot filled with blood, though he will be slightly shocked, if the instructions are done out of order.

The examine for the pot should read: ''A blessed silver pot filled with blood, garlic, and spices.'' 

'''If the examine does not say this and you attempt to kill Dessous, he will regenerate to full Hitpoints and you will need to refill the pot.'''
[[File:Graveyard_Map.png|thumb|434x434px|Reaching [[Dessous]] in the [[Morytania Graveyard]].]]

===Dealing with Dessous===
Once the pot is prepared, gear up and go to the [[Morytania Graveyard]] - see [[Dessous]]' page for routes there. Once you arrive, pour the blood on the tomb and Dessous will appear.

====The fight====
*Dessous is a [[Vampyre (monster type)#Tier 1 Vampyres|tier 1 vampyre]], meaning that [[silver weaponry]] is '''not''' required to damage him, though they do gain a 10% damage bonus. The [[Ivandis flail]] and [[blisterwood flail]] give greater bonuses, but Dessous' weakness to [[Stab weapons|stab]] means a stab weapon such as a [[dragon shortsword]] is a better option if using melee.
*[[Efaritay's aid]] will give regular weapons a 10% damage bonus against Dessous.
*He also has low [[Magic defence]], so the highest max hit spell you can cast will make it possible to kill him quickly.
*Dessous sometimes teleports to you if you use prayer. He may occasionally still do so randomly however. He will not teleport if you are within melee range.
*If you make him teleport more than three times, he'll say he's bored and will leave, causing you to have to start the fight again with a new pot.
** If the chatbox says Dessous has gotten bored and left when his health has been fully depleted, it means you haven't defeated him.
*Dying or leaving the fight earlier will require a new pot to be filled and used on the tomb.
*Dessous has two attacks: a melee attack that is rapid and accurate '''(3-tick speed, hits up to 19)''', and a combination range and magic attack that always hits '''double 5s (totaling to 10)'''. Because of this, it's strongly recommended to use '''[[protect from melee]]''', reducing his max hit to 10 at any given time.
*'''Never let your health drop below 16''', as his double 5s will sometimes lag, stacking up to 15 altogether.
*He '''cannot''' be safespotted through the fence, but it can be used to effectively [[flinch]] him.
*The [[silver pot]] is correctly prepared if the [[Magic]] and [[Ranged]] combo attack only hits a maximum of two 5s and he switches between that attack and melee.
*If you know how to 1-tick alternate your prayers, you can avoid all damage by flicking between Protect from Melee and Protect from Missiles.
[[File:Dessous spawns.gif|thumb|right|Dessous comes out of the grave.]]

====Notes for pures====
* A [[Dwarf multicannon]] can be used to kill Dessous, although it will be fairly inaccurate against him. Be sure to set up the cannon '''before''' opening the coffin; bring at least 75 cannonballs.
* [[Tick eating]] can be used to survive with low HP, but the double 5s make this difficult to do, so keeping HP above 10 is a must. For low HP pures, it's recommended to use foods that boost HP above your current level such as [[Guthix rest]]s (requires [[One Small Favour]]) and [[Saradomin brew]]s. At 10 HP, a brew will boost your HP by 3; you can eat a slice of [[pineapple pizza]] and then drink a brew in the same tick, restoring/boosting your HP to 13 after every hit Dessous makes.

Once Dessous is dead, return to [[Malak]] in [[Canifis]] to claim the [[Blood diamond]], and deposit it in the bank as quickly as possible to avoid being attacked by the Stranger. If you lose the diamond, reclaim it from Malak. You will not have to fight Dessous again.

'''Note:''' If the player wishes to keep the pot or other variants (including copies), the player should drop them before speaking with Malak or reclaiming a lost diamond from him.

==Ice diamond==
{{Needed|A sweet ([[cake]], [[chocolate cake]] (partial cakes work), [[chocolate bar]], [[cooking apple]], or [[pineapple pizza]]), [[Spiked boots]], a way to get to [[Troll child]] ([[Trollheim Teleport]], [[climbing boots]], or [[Ghommal's hilt 1]]+), several [[super restore]], [[menaphite remedy]], [[restore potion]] or [[sunlight moth mix]], or [[sunlight moth]]s, equipment and supplies to kill 5 [[Ice troll]]s and [[Kamil]] (if using magic, runes for [[fire spells]] and be on the [[standard spellbook]]. Kamil is immune to all other spells, including Iban Blast and Flames of Zamorak).|recommended=Several [[prayer potion]]s, good [[food]] ([[lobster]]s or better), and an emergency one-click teleport that doesn't have a Magic requirement, such as the [[Ectophial]] or a [[magic tablet]].}}
[[File:Ice Path map.png|thumb|right|After reaching [[Trollheim]], the [[Ice Path]] is due north-west.]]

[[Kamil]] is the next boss and arguably the hardest boss of the quest. Due to the many factors that come into play during this fight, it's highly recommended to thoroughly read this section before continuing.

* [[Protect from Melee]] is '''highly''' recommended otherwise the [[ice troll]]s and [[Ice Wolf|ice wolves]] on the way to Kamil will deal a lot of damage. The trolls are in single combat, while the wolves are in multicombat.
* It is recommended to restock and restore stats after each step because everything will be heavily drained.
* While not in combat, mainly right after entering the ice cave or hiding behind the boulder after passing the wolves, it's possible to stall the cold effect by activating a prayer that you don't have unlocked yet, and leaving the dialogue box open. This can be good for those who need to reread a section before proceeding.

===Feeding the trolls===
Make your way to [[Trollheim]], and then take the north-western path to the [[Troll child]]. If following the path from [[Burthorpe]], you will need a pair of [[Climbing Boots]] as well as [[Spiked Boots]]. You will need to pass the [[Thrower Troll (Trollheim)|thrower troll]]s; [[Protect from Missiles]] will negate their damage entirely, otherwise [[food]] or another player to tank is required. '''Do not''' enter the path with a boulder in the way; that leads to the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. Go down the previous path, which leads to the Troll child and the entrance to the [[Ice Path]]. It should start to snow as you approach the gate (note that the stat-reducing effects '''only occur once you pass through the Ice Gate''', making this a safe area to wait).

Upon talking to the Troll child, he'll cry and won't speak to you. Use a [[cake]] or [[Troll child#Sweet foods|other sweet]] on him and then speak to him again to learn that his parents are frozen farther up the path. Attempt to enter the Ice Gate, the Troll child will explain why it is frozen. Enter the Ice Gate once more to squeeze through it.

While on the Ice Path, your stats will be drained every few seconds, your run energy will instantly be reduced to 0, and you will take 1 damage every time the cold hits. All of your [[Special attack]] energy will be drained as well, so [[special attack]] [[boosts]] should be done before entering. Restore potions will recover drained stats, and Super restore potions will do the same, as well as restore Prayer points. Otherwise multiple trips can be taken by using a [[ring of dueling]] to teleport to [[Ferox Enclave]] and drink from one of the [[pools of refreshment]] to restore all stats.

Once past the Ice Gate, you have to kill five [[ice troll]]s, regardless of their level. However, the ice trolls with higher levels have lower defensive stats in exchange for higher offensive stats, making them easier to kill if using Protect from Melee. They can hit up to '''25''', so use [[Protect from Melee]] or safespot them with [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]] to be more safe. The [[dwarf multicannon]] works here, but can be inaccurate against the trolls, so be sure to bring several hundred cannonballs. They retreat when safespotted. The five trolls do not have to be killed in succession, you can leave and return without losing progress. After killing five trolls at the gate, the cave will have thawed open, allowing you to enter and proceed to Kamil.

If you forget how many trolls you've killed, you can check your progress by examining the cave or by counting the number of chatbox messages that are: ''"A chunk of ice falls away from the cave entrance..."'', if you haven't logged out, as killing a troll causes that message to appear until you've killed five. '''It is recommended you go back to the bank and restock your supplies before returning.'''

===Killing Kamil===
Enter the cave and follow the [[Ice Path]] until you reach [[Kamil]]. '''This path contains multiple [[Ice wolf|ice wolves]] capable of hitting 16s in multicombat, so protect from melee or a lot of food is a must.''' Another account can be used to tank damage as well. Continue walking and the path will open up and turn to the left, walk until you find a rock, marking the area where you will find Kamil. ''You'll get a message saying "You can feel an evil presence nearby..." when you enter the area.''

====The fight====
*[[Kamil]] uses two attacks, a strong melee attack capable of hitting up to 23, and a magic attack similar to Dessous' combination attack which always hits 5. '''Due to lag it's possible for these to stack to 10, so it's recommended to keep your hitpoints at 12 or above at all times.''' He also consistently freezes you with this attack by using a spell resembling [[Ice Barrage]], especially if outside of melee range. When frozen, you're unable to move or attack for several seconds so you'll only have a few ticks (if any) to get off attacks before being frozen again.
*Hiding behind the rock does '''not''' work anymore, and neither does having another player block Kamil. You cannot cast from behind the rock, and Kamil will teleport if you have another player blocking.
*[[Protect from Melee]] is '''highly''' recommended, otherwise you will deal very little damage due to constant eating.
*When using [[Magic]], '''only''' [[fire spells]] can damage Kamil. Due to the [[temporary skill drain]] it is recommended to use a spell significantly below your base Magic level. Even though stats can be restored, it is much more reliable. [[Fire Bolt]] is a good option, along with [[chaos gauntlets]] and a [[tome of fire]]. Also note, [[Iban Blast]] will '''not''' work against [[Kamil]] as it is not a fire spell.
*Melee combat is not recommended as he will freeze you often.
*While [[Ranged]] is not recommended, using a fast, strong weapon like the [[toxic blowpipe]] may be feasible.

====Notes for pures====
*A [[dwarf multicannon]] can also be used against Kamil, it should be set up two squares north of the rock, allowing them to safely hide from Kamil, but restock it when it runs out of cannonballs. Since the cannon's position will cause it to attack the wolves as well, be sure to bring enough (100+) cannonballs to kill him.
*Low hitpoints pures may find reaching the cave difficult, as there are dozens of trolls in the area, and it's single combat; one way around this is to enter a [[PvP world]] and remove your weapon and attack a friend, keeping them in combat with you and as such avoiding being attacked by the trolls. '''If using this method, do NOT eat until you've made it to the cave, as the delay from combat while eating will cause the trolls to attack you.'''

===The parent trap===
[[File:Desert Treasure freeing ice trolls.png|thumb|right|Thawing the ice troll child's parents.]]
Once Kamil is defeated, you need to free the troll parents. Head west from Kamil, then follow the path as it loops around. If you check the world map (or the map above), you can see the path that you need to take more easily than you can on the minimap or in game. At the end of the spiralling path, you will reach a second, darker, more visually distinct path, the beginning of which is located between two pillars of ice formations.

Put on your [[spiked boots]] and ''Use'' the ice ledge between the two pillars to climb up onto the second path. This is another long, spiralling path of ice which you must follow all the way up to reach the parents. You may slip and fall multiple times, taking some damage as you walk. Using [[super restore]]s to restore your [[Agility]] level will help here. At the top, pass through the ice gate and walk west along the third and final path until you see two large [[ice block]]s containing the troll parents. Attack the ice blocks, which have 10 [[Hitpoints]] each. They can be smashed or attacked, however with low stats it may be difficult to deal damage accurately, so the super restore from Kamil should be used.

If you have 49 [[Prayer]], [[Redemption]] can be used to heal with '''all''' of your remaining Prayer points to stay alive after running out of food as a last resort. It will sustain you if you have more [[prayer potion]]s or super restores.

After freeing the troll parents, they will take you back outside the gate and give you the [[ice diamond]]. If lost, talk to the Troll child to receive another. Kamil will not have to be fought again.

==The Ancient Pyramid==
{{Needed|[[Shantay pass (item)|Shantay pass]]es, [[waterskin]]s, [[blood diamond]], [[ice diamond]], [[smoke diamond]], [[shadow diamond]], coins for [[magic carpet]] rides (bring a [[Ring of Charos(a)]] for discounted rides)|recommended=[[Weight-reducing equipment]] such as [[graceful clothing]] or gear with high crush defence, [[Prayer items|prayer boosting equipment]], 2+ [[prayer potion]]s, 1 [[super antipoison]] (or some [[strange fruit]]), several [[energy potion]]s or 1 [[stamina potion]], [[food]] ([[summer pie]]s recommended), and an emergency teleport, 80,000 [[coins]] if buying [[Ancient Staff]].}}

With all four diamonds in your inventory, go to the [[Ancient Pyramid]] south-east of Eblis (marked "Jaldraocht Pyramid" on the world map). Place each diamond in its respective obelisk on the corners around the base of the pyramid (requires level 50 [[Magic]]). Each obelisk's tip and centre have a colour related to the specific diamond that needs to be placed there. Diamonds will only fit in the correct obelisk and cannot be removed afterwards.

[[File:Ancient Pyramid pillar.png|thumb|right|The pillar absorbs the gem.]]
When all four obelisks are activated, the pyramid will no longer be blocked, and can be entered from the top.

'''Note:''' To keep duplicate diamonds after the quest, drop the duplicates before putting the last diamond into the pyramid's last unpowered obelisk. After this is done, the quest can be safely completed without the diamonds being automatically removed from one's inventory or bank.

===Tomb raider===
[[Desert heat]] is not a problem while inside the pyramid, but most of the interior is dangerous. Level 92 [[scarab swarm]]s occasionally erupt out of the floor while level 103 [[Mummy (Ancient Pyramid)|mummies]] roam about and level 96 [[Mummy (Ancient Pyramid sarcophagus)|mummies]] spontaneously pop out of [[Sarcophagus (Ancient Pyramid)|sarcophagi]]. All monsters use [[Melee]] only, though scarab swarms can [[poison]]. 

Every time a scarab swarm appears or a mummy pops out of a sarcophagus, you will stop moving, and will not be able to move until the animation has finished. It is possible to avoid a scarab swarm entirely by making sure it is behind a mummy. There are also randomly activated traps that will send you back to the entrance of the pyramid. Bring [[weight-reducing clothing]] and plenty of [[super energy potion]]s or [[stamina potion]]s to maintain [[run energy]] or restore it quicker if it depletes. If you get caught by a trap, you will be taken outside to the south side of the pyramid but with no damage done. Do not click directly to the ladder; keep clicking to your goal as this will reduce the chances of getting caught by traps. It is useful to use a [[strange fruit]] while inside the pyramid due to the fact that it recovers 30% run energy and cures any kind of poison you may have gotten while inside the pyramid. Opening the house option interface while running to the ladder will stall the traps, reopen interface when attacked.

''The levels in the pyramid are numbered in the order the player encounters them in the quest. The purple line marks the route.''

====Outside====
Enter the pyramid from its top. The southern entrance leading to the altar can only be used after the quest has been completed.
[[File:Ancient Pyramid outside.png|center|thumb|Diagram of the pyramid's exterior]]

====Level 1====
Run from the entrance ladder to the Level 2 ladder. This level is the smallest in the area, with the fewest mummies.
[[File:Ancient Pyramid level 1.png|center|thumb|Level 1 of the Ancient Pyramid]]

====Level 2====
This level is the second smallest in area, with a few more mummies roaming about. This room might have a few traps.
[[File:Ancient Pyramid level 2.png|center|thumb|Level 2 of the Ancient Pyramid]]

====Level 3====
This level is fairly large in area, with a significant number of mummies. There is a vast amount of traps.
[[File:Ancient Pyramid level 3.png|center|thumb|Level 3 of the Ancient Pyramid]]

====Level 4====
This level is quite large in area, with mummies roaming about everywhere except the altar room. The altar room is separated by a door—do not rely on the minimap to run outside.
[[File:Ancient Pyramid level 4.png|center|thumb|Level 4 of the Ancient Pyramid]]

:''Easy tip to remember which way to start running after each level:'' north, east, south, west.

===Azzanadra===
[[File:Azzanadra is freed.png|thumb|300px|Azzanadra is released from his prison.]]
[[File:Azzanadra (Desert Treasure I) chathead.png|left]]
It is possible for a [[scarab swarm]] to spawn inside the altar room, but this only happens if it was spawning as you were entering the room. If this is the case, trap it between the door and an obstacle that is just in front of the door. Speak to [[Azzanadra]], or spawn him by using the [[Altar (Ancient Pyramid)|altar]]. He has lost track of time and believes that the [[God Wars]] are still going on. He goes on to talk about ancient unknown civilizations like [[Paddewwa]], [[Lassar]], and [[Annakarl]]. He is also surprised to see that he cannot hear [[Zaros]] in his mind anymore.

After talking, Azzanadra finally comes to peace with reality, rewarding the adventurer with the [[Ancient Magicks]] of Zaros for their efforts.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

At quest completion, you will be switched to the [[Ancient Magicks]] spellbook. Make sure you change back to the [[standard spellbook]] before you leave, if you prefer to be on it, by praying at the [[Altar (Ancient Pyramid)|altar]]. You can return here at any time via the back entrance of the pyramid to swap between the two.

'''Notes:''' 
*Praying at the [[Altar (Ancient Pyramid)|altar]] twice after completing the quest will complete a [[Desert Diary|hard task in the Desert area]]. Do this before leaving the area.
*[[Paddewwa Teleport|Teleport to Paddewwa]] to complete a [[Varrock_Diary#Hard|Varrock hard diary]] task. This requires 2 Law Runes, 1 Air Rune, 1 Fire rune, and level 54 [[Magic]].
*After exiting the pyramid, and at any point after the quest, you can speak with Eblis to obtain both an [[ancient staff]] (for 80,000 gp) and an endless supply of [[ancient signet]]s (for free).

==Walkthrough==
===Cat hunt===
{{Needed|a cat '''or''' kitten, 5 death runes, a catspeak amulet|recommended=a Varrock teleport, Games necklace}}

Head to [[Unferth]]'s house in eastern [[Burthorpe]], just north of the general store. You must have a cat or kitten with you throughout this quest, but you may choose to keep it in your inventory; it will jump out to participate in necessary dialogue.

Equip your [[catspeak amulet]] and talk to [[Unferth]], who is distressed as they have not seen [[Bob the cat]] for a week. He asks the player to talk to [[Hild]] for help, who can be found in the house just north-east of [[Unferth]]. Hild will enchant your amulet into a [[catspeak amulet(e)]] for five [[death runes]], giving it the ability to locate Bob.

Bob has one of the largest wander radius of all NPCs in the game, spawning outside Unferth's house every time there is a system update, after which he is allowed to roam up to 30,000 tiles in any direction. He is only found in [[Misthalin]], [[Asgarnia]], and the northern part of the [[Kharidian Desert]]. He '''cannot''' enter the [[Wilderness]], nor pass through the [[Shantay Pass]].

You may use the amulet to locate Bob, which works somewhat like a compass - when facing north, click the left or right whiskers to control the interface and point it in the right direction. However, he will often get stuck in a few common locations, and it may be faster to pick one of the following locations and [[World hop]] until you find him. 

Note the following table is '''not an exhaustive list of locations''', only common ones.

===Strong lineage===
Talk to [[Bob (cat)|Bob]], who explains he wanted to be alone, having fallen in love with [[Neite]], whom would never get involved with another cat with no family or status. Bob has no memory of his parents; the earliest he remembers is [[Gertrude]] taking care of him as a kitten.

Talk to [[Gertrude]] in her house just south of the [[Cooking Guild]] west of [[Varrock]] about Bob's family. While she doesn't know anything of his origins, your cat will realise that Bob might have something to do with the legend of [[Robert the Strong]]. Gertrude will suggest speaking to [[Reldo]] who might know more about the legend.

In the [[Varrock Palace]] library, talk to [[Reldo]], who will read an excerpt from a book on the history of Gielinor that covers the folk tales surrounding [[Robert the Strong]] and his personal crusade against the [[Dragonkin]]. Remarking that it's odd that nobody knows where Bob comes from, your cat will suggest that Bob is in fact [[Robert the Strong]].

Return to [[Bob]], using the catspeak amulet to locate him if he has changed locations. Bob will not remember any of the details mentioned in the tales, with your cat suggesting that the [[Sphinx]] may be able to help with accessing Bob's memories of Robert the Strong via hypnosis.

===Hidden memories===
[[File:A Tail of Two Cats - talking to sphinx.png|thumb|The Sphinx talking to Bob the cat in the desert.]]
{{Needed|recommended=[[Nardah teleport]] and 200 [[coins]] for the magic carpet (100 with [[Ring of Charos(a)]]). Additional 80 [[coins]] if you are buying the desert outfit in Sophanem.}}

Head to [[Sophanem]], using the [[pharaoh's sceptre]] to teleport there if you have one; otherwise a good option is to use a [[Nardah teleport]], then take the [[magic carpet]] to [[Sophanem]].

If you still need the desert outfit, you can buy it from [[Raetul and Co's Cloth Store.]], which can be found east of the [[Sphinx]].

Talk to the Sphinx in Sophanem, south-east of the northern [[Pyramid Plunder|pyramid]]. Ask her for help, and after a bit, you'll have the option to view a five-minute cutscene or get a brief summary of what happens. '''''If you choose the brief summary, you won't be offered the option of being teleported to [[Burthorpe]].'''''

During the cutscene, the Sphinx will teleport Bob to Sophanem and hypnotise him. Bob, thinking back on his earliest memories, recalls himself as [[Robert the Strong]]. He sees himself looking over at a tower beside [[Odysseus]] his panther companion, followed by a battle between them and a [[Dragonkin (A Tail of Two Cats)|Dragonkin]]. The Dragonkin manages to slay the panther and weaken Robert, however Robert manages to kill the Dragonkin.<gallery captionalign="center">

After the cutscene, the Sphinx summons [[Neite]], explaining to her that unlocking Bob's memories has proved that he is in fact Robert the Strong. Neite will be impressed, with Bob asking the player to look after Unferth while the two go away for a few days. He will give the player a list of [[chores]] to help him with.

If you chose to hear the long version, you will be given the option to teleport back to Burthorpe; otherwise, you can make your way back there using the [[Minigame Teleport]] to [[Burthorpe Games Room]] (or [[games necklace]] if it is on cooldown).

===Bob's list===
{{Needed|Catspeak amulet (wear it), A vial of water, logs, a tinderbox, a bucket of milk, a chocolate cake, shears, a rake, a seed dibber, 4 potato seeds, Desert shirt or Druid's robe top or Medical gown, Desert robe or Druid's robe|recommended=Varrock teleports, a games necklace}}
[[File:A Tail of Two Cats - cutting Unferth's hair.png|thumb|One of the chores Bob asks you to do while he is gone.]]
Returning to [[Unferth]]'s house in [[Burthorpe]], perform the following chores from the list given to you:

{{Checklist|
*To tend the garden, use your [[rake]] on [[Unferth's patch]] in the yard just north of the house and plant four [[potato seed]]s.
**The patch will take 15–35 minutes to grow. Your cat will notify you once it is done, assuming you completed the other chores by then. The chore will not count as completed until it is grown.
*To tidy the house, make the [[bed (A Tail of Two Cats)|bed]] by clicking on it.
*To warm the human, use the [[logs]] on the [[fireplace (A Tail of Two Cats)|fireplace]] and light it.
*To feed the human, '''use''' (not eat), the [[chocolate cake]] and [[bucket of milk]] on the southern [[table (A Tail of Two Cats)|table]]. A slice of cake does not work.
*To tidy the human, use your [[shears]] on Unferth to shave his hair. You will continue this animation until he becomes bald, so do not click away.
}}

After you've completed the chores, talk to Unferth again. He'll tell you that he doesn't feel so good and insists to see a doctor, with your cat suggesting the [[Apothecary]], found in the south-western portion of [[Varrock]].

The [[Apothecary]] will tell you that he has visited Unferth countless times, whom is a {{wp|hypochondria|hypochondriac}} - he isn't ill but thinks he is. He suggests the player convinces Unferth that they are a doctor or nurse and gives them a [[vial of water]] as a placebo. Pick either a [[doctor's hat]] or [[nurse hat]] from the Apothecary, and wear some white robes (princess robes and graceful outfit don't work).

Return to Unferth wearing the disguise and with your weapon/shield slot unequipped. The player will convince him that the vial of water is in fact a 'miracle cure' for all known illnesses, and a few unknown ones. After drinking the water, he will declare that he is cured. Your cat will then suggest that Bob must be back by now.

===Love-cats ===
Find [[Bob (cat)|Bob]] again and talk to him; you may need to logout and login again to get him to reappear.

You'll see a cutscene showing all the adventures the two have been on, including a [[magic carpet]] ride in [[Sophanem]], a conversation between Bob and the [[King Black Dragon]] (a player spoof known as [[R4ng3rNo0b889]] also tries to attack the dragon, but the dragon kills him instantly), and a journey on the [[Fishing Trawler]] ship.

After the cutscene, you will be teleported in front of [[Unferth]]'s house. Talk to Unferth, who will be happy to have Bob back, exclaiming that he came back on his own. He also found a [[present]] left under the bed, addressed to the player.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

==Trivia==
*The quest had a scrapped [[cutscene]] which included [[Bob (cat)|Bob]] and [[Neite]]'s wedding (with Neite wearing a wedding veil and Bob wearing a white bow tie), as well as several other unused NPCs, such as their son Beite, two gnomes (with one wielding a {{WP|Daguerreotype}} camera) and [[Odysseus]]' ghost. As the developer of the quest resigned before finishing it, the cutscene was never developed{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1087709036538224640|date=25 January 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/100009|archivedate=20 December 2019|quote=I don't believe the dev ever wrote any code for that. He resigned before the quest was completed, and the rest of us shepherded it through the end of testing and launch. It's a shame - he was a clever programmer.}}, but the NPCs remained in the game code.
*If you have completed [[Dragon Slayer II]], upon telling [[Juna]] a story about this quest, Juna will respond with dialogue related to the events of Dragon Slayer II. This is unique in that Dragon Slayer II is the only quest that Juna has two lines of dialogue for, and this is her only dialogue that pertains to two quests that are independent of each other.
*The name of the quest "A Tail of Two Cats" is a reference to the Charles Dickens novel ''{{wp|A Tale of Two Cities}}''.
* When you first speak to Bob he says "Love looks not with the eyes but with the mind. And therefore is winged Cupid painted blind". This line is spoken by Helena to Lysander in Shakespeare's ''{{wp|A Midsummer Night's Dream}}''.
*In the second cutscene, there is a spoof scene of the film ''{{wp|Titanic (1997 film)|Titanic}}''; Bob is standing on the bow of the ship and says "I'm king of Gielinor!"
*Upon examining the potato plants in Unferth's house, it says "You say Potato, I say Poh-tar-to". This is a reference to a 1937 film ''{{wp|Shall We Dance (1937 film)|Shall We Dance}}''.
*When starting the quest and asking Unferth when they had last seen Bob, they respond with "Well he usually comes back to me once a week. Usually on a Wednesday a bit before lunchtime". This is a reference to game updates which usually happen on a Wednesday at this time as Bob spawns next to Unferth, explaining why Bob returns once a week when the servers are rebooted with a game update.
*Just before getting hypnotised, Bob responds to the claim he is Robert the Strong with "I'm just this cat you know". This is a reference to {{WP|The Hitchiker's Guide to the Galaxy}}, where Zaphod Beeblebrox (the self-declared most interesting being in the universe) is described by his psychiatrist as being "just zis guy, you know?".
*Like the standard version of [[King Black Dragon]], the version seen in the ending cutscene of [[A Tail of Two Cats]] has a festive override wearing a [[Santa hat]], [[purple partyhat]], and [[green partyhat]] during [[Christmas events]].

==Walkthrough==
===The monk===
[[File:Monk (Devious Minds) chathead.png|left|70px]]
Head to the [[Paterdomus Temple]], north-east of [[Varrock]] and the [[Digsite]]; the same temple encountered during [[Priest in Peril]]. Talk to the [[Monk (Devious Minds)|monk]] just outside, who will request your help. On his recent travels to [[Morytania]], he learned of a weapon from the lands to the far east that he believes will be valuable in the [[Saradomin]]ist fight against darkness. In order to help him build such a weapon, he wants you to take a two-handed mithril sword to [[Doric]], a dwarf whose whetstone he considers unmatchable.
{{Clear|left}}

===A strange weapon===
[[File:Making slender blade.gif|frame|A player using Doric's whetstone.]]
{{Needed|A [[mithril 2h sword]] and a [[bow string]]|skills={{SCP|Smithing|65|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} to create a slender blade, {{SCP|Fletching|50|link=yes}} {{Boostable|yes}} to create the bow-sword}}
Head to [[Doric]]'s house just north of [[Falador]], and use a [[mithril 2h sword]] on the whetstone inside to make a [[slender blade]], then attach a [[bow string]] (the [[bow string spool]] works) to it to make the [[bow-sword]].

When you've made the bow-sword, make your way back to the monk. You can use the [[balloon transport system]] to fly from Taverley back to the Earth Altar by using a set of [[willow logs]], if you have already unlocked the [[Varrock]] destination.

===A gift for Entrana===
{{Needed|The [[bow-sword]] and a [[large pouch|large]]/[[colossal pouch]]}}

Give the [[bow-sword]] to the Monk and he will be grateful for it; although he needs one more favour. He wants you to secretly deliver a special gift to [[Entrana]] for a special ceremony. He will give you an [[Orb (Devious Minds)|orb]] to smuggle; to do this, the Monk suggests using the [[Abyss]] to access the [[Law Altar]] on the island. He also wants you to protect the delicate orb by storing it inside an [[essence pouch]]. '''Only''' a [[large pouch]] or [[colossal pouch]] may be used. The large pouch '''will be destroyed during the quest''', whereas the colossal pouch will survive. Your pouch must not be degraded — if it must be repaired, contact the [[Dark Mage (Abyss)|dark mage]] either by the [[Astral Contact]] spell or directly in the Abyss.

[[File:Large pouch detail.png|right|180px]]
Large pouches can be obtained as rewards from the [[Rewards Guardian]] at [[Guardians of the Rift]] or as drops from [[abyssal leech]]es, [[abyssal guardian|guardians]] and [[abyssal walker|walkers]] found within the [[Abyss]] or the [[Abyssal Area]]. You must obtain the smaller pouches first. You do not need to have the [[Runecraft]] level (50) in order for it to be dropped, but it is required to use it.

Use the orb on your large or colossal pouch to create an [[Large pouch (Devious Minds)|illuminated large pouch]]. 

As usual, no other [[weapons]] or [[armour]] are allowed on [[Entrana]]. The [[Abyss]] is intended to be the only way to enter [[Entrana]] with the orb. However, players with a [[Greater teleport focus (facility)|Greater Teleport Focus]] on their boat can circumvent this by casting [[Teleport to Boat]] on a ship docked at Entrana. If using the [[Abyss]], it is accessible through a teleport from the [[Mage of Zamorak]], who is located in the [[Wilderness]] at the point where the [[River Lum]] goes underground, just north of [[Edgeville]]. Enter the Abyss to reach the Law Altar, and through it, Entrana.

:'''Note for Ultimate Ironman players:''' The orb and the [[Large pouch (Devious Minds)|large pouch]] containing the orb will be lost if the player dies after putting the orb in the pouch, including to deathpile or deathbank. If obtaining a large pouch from Abyss, make sure to deathpile or deathbank gear and items after obtaining the pouch but before putting the orb in it (the orb is always lost on death, players can get a new orb after dying from the Monk at Paterdomus). Do not put the orb in the pouch before you deathbank or deathpile and are fully ready to go to [[Entrana]]. Note the pouch used for this quest will be lost regardless as part of successful completion.

===Surprise!===
{{Needed|The [[large pouch (Devious Minds)]]}}
[[File:Devious minds - temple attack.png|thumb|220px|The assassination.]]
On [[Entrana]], head to the church at the heart of the island and use your pouch on the altar. A cutscene ensues, wherein the monks are walking towards the altar to begin the ceremony, one of them holding a mysterious [[Relic (Devious Minds)|relic]], when suddenly an [[Assassin]] wielding the [[bow-sword]] teleports in, swiftly kills the monks and steals the relic. After teleporting away, the orb on the altar explodes.
{{Listen
|title = [[Assassin Attack! (Devious Minds)|Assassin Attack!]]
|align = right
|filename = Assassin Attack! (Devious Minds).ogg
|desc = The jingle that plays during the cutscene.}}
After the cutscene, talk to the [[High Priest (Entrana)|High Priest]]. It turns out that the orb you delivered was in fact a teleport beacon, which allowed the assassin to sneak into the holy island, unhindered. After questioning the player, he will conclude that no worshipper of Saradomin would ever do this; he wants you to return to the [[Paterdomus Temple]] to look for any trace of the 'monk'.

[[File:Devious Minds - dead monk.png|thumb|220px|The dead monk at Paterdomus.]]
On arriving back at the [[Paterdomus Temple]], the [[Monk (Devious Minds)|monk]] you helped is gone, replaced by a [[Dead Monk]]. Searching the body reveals that he has been killed by powerful magic, and is not the same person you spoke to earlier.

Go back to [[Entrana]] and speak with the [[High Priest (Entrana)|High Priest]] again (you can travel via [[Port Sarim]] this time if you wish). He will reveal that the relic was once part of a powerful artefact, and asks you to report it to [[Sir Tiffy Cashien]]. Find [[Sir Tiffy Cashien|Sir Tiffy]] sitting on a bench in [[Falador Park]]. Unsurprised, he reveals that the [[Temple Knights]] already had intel on the relic being stolen. After the player asks if there is anything they can do to help, Sir Tiffy says they will be in touch.

'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
